max_penalty_text: será responsabilizado por danos decorrentes do conteúdo impulsionado se, após ordem judicial específica, não tomar as providências
quote: será responsabilizado por danos decorrentes do conteúdo impulsionado se, após ordem judicial específica, não tomar as providências
penalty_formula: Liability for damages arising from the boosted content; claimant and amount not specified in this provision

authority: juiz eleitoral
triggered_by: Fines of non-criminal nature imposed in electoral proceedings; the conduct triggering each fine is not specified in this part
max_penalty_text: Amount not stated in this part; judge must set a value above the legal minimum
quote: Na fixação das multas de natureza não penal, o juiz eleitoral deverá considerar a condição econômica do infrator
penalty_formula: Judge considers economic condition of the offender, gravity of the act and repercussion of the infraction, justifying any value above the legal minimum

authority: Justiça Eleitoral (juiz eleitoral)
triggered_by: Non-compliance, even partial, with a decision recognising the right of reply
max_penalty_text: R$ 6.000,00 (seis mil reais) a R$ 20.000,00 (vinte mil reais), duplicada em caso de reiteração de conduta, sem prejuízo da responsabilização criminal
quote: decisão que conceder a resposta sujeitará o infrator ao pagamento de multa no valor de R$ 5.000,00 (cinco mil reais) a R$ 30.000,00 (trinta mil reais),
penalty_formula: Range R$ 6.000 to R$ 20.000; doubled in case of repeated conduct; without prejudice to criminal liability

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Offended party is a third party (not candidate, party or coalition) that used granted free-broadcast reply time without answering the facts
max_penalty_text: R$ 3.000,0 (três mil reais) a R$ 10.000,00 (dez mil reais)
quote: tratando-se de terceiros, ficarão sujeitos à suspensão de igual tempo em eventuais novos pedidos de direito de resposta e à multa no valor de R$ 3.000,0 (três mil reais) a R$ 10.000,00 (dez mil reais)
penalty_formula: Range R$ 3.000 to R$ 10.000

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Offended party is a third party that used granted free-broadcast reply time without answering the facts
max_penalty_text: Suspension of equal time in future right-of-reply requests
quote: tratando-se de terceiros, ficarão sujeitos à suspensão de igual tempo em eventuais novos pedidos de direito de resposta
penalty_formula: Suspension of time equal to the time at issue, applied to future right-of-reply requests

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Offended candidate, party or coalition used granted free-broadcast reply time without answering the facts broadcast
max_penalty_text: Identical time subtracted from the respective electoral programme
quote: terá subtraído tempo idêntico do respectivo programa eleitoral
penalty_formula: Subtraction of time identical to the time at issue from the offended party's electoral programme

authority: Justiça Eleitoral (juiz eleitoral)
triggered_by: Internet application provider does not promptly remove offensive content after the electoral judge orders its removal
max_penalty_text: Coercive measures including pecuniary ones; amounts not stated in this part
quote: inclusive as de natureza pecuniária decorrentes do descumprimento da decisão jurisdicional
penalty_formula: Coercive measures as determined by the court; the text cross-refers to pecuniary measures for non-compliance with the judicial decision

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Cross-referenced sanction for unlawful conduct in actions against responsible persons (text refers to fine or ineligibility)
max_penalty_text: Inelegibilidade (duration not stated in this part)
quote: nas hipóteses em que seja cabível sua punição com sanção de multa ou de inelegibilidade
penalty_formula: Sanction referred to in text; the text does not set the ineligibility term in this part

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Action for party disaffiliation without just cause, once the claim is upheld
max_penalty_text: Loss of elected office or mandate
quote: será decretada a perda do cargo ou mandato eletivo
penalty_formula: Decreed upon final judgment in the ordinary instance; the vice or substitute takes office within 10 days, unless an interim measure applies

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Default on installments of a court-ordered payment plan (three installments unpaid, consecutive or not)
max_penalty_text: Fine of ten per cent on the value of unpaid installments
quote: sendo imposta ao devedor multa de dez por cento sobre o valor das prestações não pagas
penalty_formula: 10% of the value of unpaid installments

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Inscription of a voter or change of electoral domicile using false information, false document or other fraud
max_penalty_text: Pena – reclusão, de dois a quatro anos.
quote: Pena – reclusão, de dois a quatro anos.
penalty_formula: Plus one-half to two-thirds and a fine for organising, facilitating or inducing transfer of a plural number of voters by falsehood or fraud (§2º); same penalties for inducing a specific voter (§1º)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Dissemination or sharing, from the start of the convention period, of facts known to be false or grossly decontextualised with capacity to influence voters
max_penalty_text: Pena – reclusão, de um a quatro anos, e multa.
quote: Pena – reclusão, de um a quatro anos, e multa.
penalty_formula: Plus one-third to two-thirds if done through paid boosting or mass-messaging tools (§1º); plus one-half to two-thirds if aimed at disrupting voting or results processes (§2º)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Producing, offering, using or acquiring services or databases able to disseminate information outside the limits of electoral law
max_penalty_text: Pena - reclusão, de dois a quatro anos, e multa.
quote: Pena - reclusão, de dois a quatro anos, e multa.
penalty_formula: Plus one-half to two-thirds if the conduct aims to disseminate disinformation (parágrafo único)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Impeding, destroying, altering or disturbing a means of electoral propaganda
max_penalty_text: Pena – detenção, de um a dois anos e multa.
quote: Pena – detenção, de um a dois anos e multa.
penalty_formula: Increase where violence or serious threat is used to prevent propaganda acts; the text says the violence penalties apply in addition

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Use of political violence against one or more women to restrict candidacy or election or to hinder political rights
max_penalty_text: Pena – reclusão de três a seis anos e multa.
quote: Pena – reclusão de três a seis anos e multa.
penalty_formula: Without prejudice to penalties for the violence itself; special evidentiary weight to the victim's statements and circumstantial evidence (§2º)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Contracting or disseminating a fraudulent electoral poll
max_penalty_text: Pena: reclusão, de dois e quatro anos e multa de duzentos a quatrocentos mil reais
penalty_reference: Livro XXII, Título V (article number not shown in this part)
quote: Pena: reclusão, de dois e quatro anos e multa de duzentos a quatrocentos mil reais
penalty_formula: Fine of R$ 200.000 to R$ 400.000, set from the economic capacity of the agent and the reach of the poll's dissemination

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Active electoral corruption: offering or giving an advantage to obtain a vote or abstention, even if not accepted
max_penalty_text: Pena - preclusão, de dois a seis anos e multa.
quote: Pena - preclusão, de dois a seis anos e multa.
penalty_formula: Increase by one-half to two-thirds for hiring intermediaries to buy votes (parágrafo único). The word preclusão appears in the text, likely a typo for reclusão

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Passive electoral corruption: soliciting or receiving an advantage to give or withhold a vote
max_penalty_text: Pena - reclusão, de um a quatro anos e multa.
quote: Pena - reclusão, de um a quatro anos e multa.
penalty_formula: Judge may withhold the penalty or reduce it by one-third to two-thirds if the voter accepted the advantage out of destitution and did not originally request it (parágrafo único)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Electoral extortion: coercion by violence or serious threat to obtain a vote or abstention
max_penalty_text: Pena - reclusão, de quatro a dez anos e multa.
quote: Pena - reclusão, de quatro a dez anos e multa.
penalty_formula: Plus one-third to one-half if committed with a weapon or with several participants (§1º); if liberty is restricted, six to twelve years plus fine; if grave bodily injury results, sixteen to twenty-four years; if death results, twenty-four to thirty years (§2º)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Coercion by violence or serious threat to force candidates, contracted or volunteer supporters, or party or community leaders to act or refrain from acting in an electoral dispute
max_penalty_text: Pena – reclusão, de três a seis anos, e multa.
quote: Pena – reclusão, de três a seis anos, e multa.
penalty_formula: Penalty as stated; no separate aggravation in this article

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Authorising or improperly using public administration premises, funds, equipment, staff or services to benefit a party, coalition or candidate
max_penalty_text: Pena - reclusão, de dois a quatro anos e multa.
quote: Pena - reclusão, de dois a quatro anos e multa.
penalty_formula: Increase by one-third to one-half if the agent holds an elected mandate or a leadership or direction role in a public body or party (parágrafo único)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Donating, receiving, holding or using campaign funds outside the electoral law rules, or without accounting
max_penalty_text: Pena – reclusão, de dois a cinco anos, e multa.
quote: Pena – reclusão, de dois a cinco anos, e multa.
penalty_formula: Increase by one-half if funds come from prohibited sources and doubled if from a criminal infraction with concealment (§1º); judge may withhold or reduce by one-third to two-thirds for a small, lawful-origin accounting omission from an authorised donor (§2º)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Appropriation by a candidate or campaign financial administrator of campaign assets or funds for own or another's benefit
max_penalty_text: Pena – reclusão, de dois a cinco anos, e multa.
quote: Pena – reclusão, de dois a cinco anos, e multa.
penalty_formula: Penalty as stated; no separate aggravation in this article

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Accessing electronic ballot box, voting system or Electoral Justice data without authorisation to interfere with or alter votes, instructions or configurations
max_penalty_text: Pena – reclusão, de quatro a oito anos e multa
quote: Pena – reclusão, de quatro a oito anos e multa
penalty_formula: Same penalties apply to whoever uses the data so obtained or introduced (parágrafo único)

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Falsifying voting results or tally records, manual or electronic, by altering or suppressing data or other fraudulent means
max_penalty_text: Pena - reclusão, de cinco a dez anos e multa
quote: Pena - reclusão, de cinco a dez anos e multa
penalty_formula: Penalty as stated; no separate aggravation in this article

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Voting in another person's place or using a false document to vote
max_penalty_text: Pena - reclusão, de dois a cinco anos, e multa.
quote: Pena - reclusão, de dois a cinco anos, e multa.
penalty_formula: Penalty as stated; no separate aggravation in this article

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Violating the secrecy of the vote, even one's own, or of the electoral ballot box
max_penalty_text: Pena - reclusão, de um a quatro anos e multa.
quote: Pena - reclusão, de um a quatro anos e multa.
penalty_formula: Penalty as stated; no separate aggravation in this article

authority: Justiça Eleitoral
triggered_by: Destroying, damaging, disabling, suppressing or hiding an electoral ballot box containing votes
max_penalty_text: Pena - reclusão, de três a seis anos e multa.
quote: Pena - reclusão, de três a seis anos e multa.
penalty_formula: Penalty as stated; no separate aggravation in this article

authority: Not named in Art. 11-D (accreditation is granted by the Secretaria Especial da Receita Federal do Brasil, Art. 11-A §6)
triggered_by: Accredited firm fails commitments II-V of Art. 11-B §1 (sustainability, renewable electricity, WUE, R&D investment) within the regulatory deadline

provision: Lei 11.196/2005, Art. 11-D, as inserted by Art. 2

authority: Not named in Art. 11-E
triggered_by: Co-accredited supplier does not complete the sale and delivery of the ICT product to an accredited firm (Art. 11-C §9)

provision: Lei 11.196/2005, Art. 11-E, as inserted by Art. 2

authority: Tax authority (lançamento de ofício; body not named)
triggered_by: Suspended taxes due under Arts. 11-D, 11-E or 11-F are not paid
provision: Lei 11.196/2005, Art. 11-G, as inserted by Art. 2
quote: caberá lançamento de ofício, com aplicação de juros e da multa de que trata o art. 44 da Lei nº 9.430, de 27 de dezembro de 1996
penalty_formula: Ex officio tax assessment with interest and the fine of Art. 44 of Lei 9.430/1996

authority: Administrative decision (body not named), under Lei 9.784/1999
triggered_by: Failure to make the domestic-market capacity available (Art. 11-B §1 I)
max_penalty_text: suspensão dos benefícios em novas aquisições; cancelamento da habilitação ao Redata
provision: Lei 11.196/2005, Art. 11-H caput and §1, as inserted by Art. 2
quote: implicará suspensão dos benefícios em novas aquisições, na forma estabelecida em regulamento
penalty_formula: Benefits suspended on new acquisitions for the firm and its economic group; converted automatically to cancellation if not cured within 180 days; after cancellation the firm and its group may re-join only after 2 years; appeal has no suspensive effect

authority: Set by regulation
triggered_by: Breach of the conditions of the law or of the commitments assumed
max_penalty_text: exclusão do Redata
penalty_reference: Procedure to be set by regulation (Art. 11-B §8 III)
provision: Lei 11.196/2005, Art. 11-B §8 III, as inserted by Art. 2
quote: o procedimento de exclusão do Redata, em caso de descumprimento das condições previstas nesta Lei ou nos compromissos assumidos

authority: not stated in text
triggered_by: Any irregularity regarding compliance with the requirements and obligations set by this law (Art. 5º caput)
max_penalty_text: No monetary penalty stated. Loss of the differentiated tax treatment, with restoration of the conventional ICMS system, and the taxpayer must pay the ICMS due on its operations within normal deadlines.
cure_period: 30 (trinta) dias to present the missing documentation or remedy the irregularity after notification (Art. 5º § 1º)
quote: Perderá o direito à utilização de qualquer tratamento tributário diferenciado previsto nesta lei, com a consequente restauração da sistemática convencional de apuração do ICMS

authority: Not stated in the text; revocation is described as automatic
triggered_by: Art. 4º, parágrafo único, items 1-6: (1) non-compliance with the conditions fixed in the special regime; (2) project change without communication and approval by the Secretaria da Fazenda e Planejamento; (3) conduct or activity harmful to the environment; (4) crimes against the tax order or tax evasion; (5) definitive cessation of activities; (6) conduct or activity harmful to the economic order
max_penalty_text: No monetary penalty stated; the consequence is automatic revocation (cassação) of the special regime
quote: O regime especial será automaticamente cassado nas seguintes hipóteses

authority: Provedor de aplicação de internet (por iniciativa própria) ou Poder Judiciário (por determinação judicial)
triggered_by: Descumprimento das regras do caput e dos §§ 3º e 3º-A do art. 9º-B (conteúdo sintético em propaganda eleitoral e proibição de publicação nas 72 horas antes e 24 horas após o pleito)
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text; the measure is removal of content or unavailability of the communication service.
penalty_reference: Sem prejuízo de apuração nos termos do § 2º do art. 9º-C (not reproduced in this text)
cure_period: Immediate removal ('imediata'); no cure period stated.

penalty_formula: Not applicable: the text prescribes content removal or service unavailability, not a monetary penalty.

authority: Juíza ou juiz (judicial determination)
triggered_by: Determination of suspension of a profile referred to in the preceding paragraph of art. 9º-D (that paragraph is not reproduced in this text)
max_penalty_text: Not stated; the judge sets the duration of the measure.
cure_period: Duration set by the judge ('prazo de vigência'); no cure period stated.
quote: A juíza ou o juiz, ao determinar a suspensão de perfil referida no parágrafo anterior, indicará o prazo de vigência da medida.
penalty_formula: Not stated in this text.

authority: Justiça Eleitoral (judicial process, § 1º); provedores de aplicação (exclusion, § 2º)
triggered_by: Reiterated publications by a false, anonymous or automated profile that constitute electoral crime or notoriously false or grossly decontextualized facts recognized by the Electoral Justice
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text.
penalty_reference: None cited in this text; § 3º refers to art. 9º-D, § 5º for other cases.
quote: A remoção de perfil será feita quando se tratar de usuário comprovadamente falso
penalty_formula: Not stated in this text.

authority: Court issuing the judicial order (not further specified in this text)
triggered_by: Violation of art. 15 and its paragraphs (the subject of art. 15 is not reproduced in this text)
max_penalty_text: Daily fine (astreintes); no amount stated in this text.
penalty_reference: Código de Processo Civil (applied subsidiarily; no article cited)
quote: A violação do disposto neste artigo e em seus parágrafos poderá ensejar a adoção de medidas coercitivas
penalty_formula: Daily fine ('multa diária') to ensure effectiveness of the judicial order; amount not stated; Código de Processo Civil applies subsidiarily.

authority: Not stated in this text (Código Eleitoral criminal provisions cited)
triggered_by: Producing, offering or selling a video with false content about parties or candidates
max_penalty_text: Same penalties as the caput of art. 90 (caput not reproduced in this text); no amount stated.
penalty_reference: Código Eleitoral, art. 323, § 1º (cited); caput of art. 90 (not reproduced in this text)
quote: Nas mesmas penas incorre quem produz, oferece ou vende vídeo com conteúdo inverídico acerca de partidos ou candidatas e candidatos
penalty_formula: Not stated in this text.

authority: Court on summary conviction (offence under s. 36(3))
triggered_by: Individual who contravenes s. 36(2) by failing to take reasonably necessary measures to keep confidential information disclosed to an arbitrator from being disclosed outside the arbitration

quote: for a first offence, to a fine of not more than $5,000
penalty_formula: Fixed fine amounts by offence count; no revenue-based formula stated

authority: Court on summary conviction (offence under s. 56(1))
triggered_by: Individual who contravenes s. 55(2) by knowingly disclosing, or allowing disclosure of, designated confidential information

quote: Every individual who contravenes subsection 55(2) is guilty of an offence and is liable on summary conviction
penalty_formula: Fixed fine amounts by offence count; no revenue-based formula stated

authority: Court on summary conviction (offence under s. 56(2))
triggered_by: Individual who contravenes s. 55(6) by using disclosed information other than as permitted; defence of due diligence in s. 56(3)
max_penalty_text: Fine of not more than $5,000 for a first offence; not more than $10,000 for a second or subsequent offence
quote: Every individual who contravenes subsection 55(6) is guilty of an offence and is liable on summary conviction
penalty_formula: Fixed fine amounts by offence count; no revenue-based formula stated

authority: Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (notices of violation under s. 64; decisions under s. 66)
triggered_by: Individual operator, director, officer, employee, agent or mandatary of an operator who contravenes the Act, regulations, an order or an undertaking (s. 60(1)(a)), or who makes a material misrepresentation or intentional omission to a designated person (s. 60(1)(b)); or an individual who contravenes s. 7(2) (s. 60(2))
max_penalty_text: Not more than $25,000 for a first violation; not more than $50,000 for each subsequent violation

authority: Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (notices of violation under s. 64; decisions under s. 66)
triggered_by: Entity that contravenes the Act, regulations, an order or an undertaking (s. 60(1)(a)), makes a material misrepresentation or intentional omission to a designated person (s. 60(1)(b)), or contravenes s. 7(2) (s. 60(2))
max_penalty_text: Not more than $10 million for a first violation; not more than $15 million for each subsequent violation
cure_period: Not stated in this Act; due diligence defence available under s. 69(1) (not a cure period)
quote: of not more than $10 million for a first violation and of not more than $15 million for each subsequent violation
penalty_formula: Amount set by reference to factors in s. 61(2); each day a violation is continued is a separate violation (s. 60(3)); regulations may increase amounts (s. 76(b)). No revenue-based cap stated

authority: Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (order)

penalty_formula: Not stated in this text.

authority: Banco de España

authority: Banco de España

authority: Banco de España
triggered_by: Sanctions under Ley 10/2014 applicable to valuation activity (Art. 61)
max_penalty_text: Disqualification sanctions (inhabilitación) referred to credit institutions, valuation companies and approved professionals; no amounts stated
penalty_reference: Ley 10/2014, Título IV capítulo III; Art. 61 c)
quote: Las sanciones de inhabilitación se entenderán referidas a entidades de crédito, a sociedades de tasación y a los profesionales homologados señalados en el artículo 18.1.

authority: Banco de España
triggered_by: Valuation infractions (Arts. 58 to 60) by valuation companies, credit institutions providing valuation, their administrators and directors, and approved professionals (Art. 18.1)
max_penalty_text: Sanctions of Ley 10/2014 applicable with the modifications of Art. 61; no amounts stated in this part
penalty_reference: Ley 10/2014, de 26 de junio, Título IV capítulo III; Art. 61 a) to c)
quote: les serán aplicables las sanciones previstas en la Ley 10/2014, de 26 de junio, con las siguientes modificaciones:

authority: Banco de España
triggered_by: Infractions by the external covered bond control body classified as very serious, serious or minor (Arts. 61 ter and 61 quater 1)
max_penalty_text: Fines per Ley 10/2014 Arts. 97, 98 and 99 for very serious, serious and minor infractions respectively, with the specialties of Art. 61 quater; amounts in the following tiers
penalty_reference: Ley 10/2014, de 26 de junio, arts. 97, 98 and 99
quote: La comisión de infracciones muy graves, graves y leves será sancionada, respectivamente, conforme a lo previsto en los artículos 97, 98 y 99 de la Ley 10/2014

authority: Banco de España
triggered_by: Very serious infraction by the external covered bond control body (Art. 61 ter 1), sanctioned under Ley 10/2014 Art. 97.1.a) 2.º
max_penalty_text: Up to 5,000,000 euros (reduced from up to 10,000,000 euros in Ley 10/2014 Art. 97.1.a) 2.º)

max_penalty_text: Up to 2,500,000 euros (reduced from up to 5,000,000 euros in Ley 10/2014 Art. 98.1.b))

max_penalty_text: Up to 500,000 euros (reduced from up to 1,000,000 euros in Ley 10/2014 Art. 99.1.b))
quote: la multa de hasta 1.000.000 de euros señalada en el artículo 99.1.b) pasará a ser de hasta 500.000 euros.
penalty_formula: Company's own funds are taken into account when fixing the fine (Art. 61 quater 3)

authority: Banco de España
triggered_by: Sanctions on administrators and directors of an external covered bond control body, under Ley 10/2014 Art. 100.1.a)
max_penalty_text: Up to 2,500,000 euros (reduced from up to 5,000,000 euros in Ley 10/2014 Art. 100.1.a))
quote: la multa de hasta 5.000.000 de euros señalada en el artículo 100.1.a) pasará a ser de hasta 2.500.000 euros.

authority: Banco de España
triggered_by: Sanctions on administrators and directors of an external covered bond control body, under Ley 10/2014 Art. 101.1.a)
max_penalty_text: Up to 1,250,000 euros (reduced from up to 2,500,000 euros in Ley 10/2014 Art. 101.1.a))
quote: la multa de hasta 2.500.000 euros señalada en el artículo 101.1.a) pasará a ser de hasta 1.250.000 euros.

authority: Banco de España
triggered_by: Sanctions on administrators and directors of an external covered bond control body, under Ley 10/2014 Art. 102.1
max_penalty_text: Up to 250,000 euros (reduced from up to 500,000 euros in Ley 10/2014 Art. 102.1)
quote: la multa de hasta 500.000 euros señalada en el artículo 102.1. pasará a ser de hasta 250.000 euros.

authority: Administración pública competente (Art. 50); órganos competentes en materia de consumo, autonómicos o estatales (Art. 52 bis)
triggered_by: Infracciones en materia de defensa de los consumidores y usuarios (Art. 47), calificadas como leves, graves o muy graves (Art. 48)
max_penalty_text: Leves: entre 150 y 10.000 euros; graves: entre 10.001 y 100.000 euros; muy graves: 100.001 a 1.000.000 euros; amounts may be exceeded up to a multiple of the illicit benefit
cure_period: No fixed period. Art. 48.4: classification is reduced one level if the responsible party diligently corrects the irregularities before proceedings open, subject to listed exceptions
quote: Infracciones muy graves: ente 100.001 y 1.000.000 euros
penalty_formula: Amounts may be exceeded up to 2-4 times (leves), 4-6 times (graves) and 6-8 times (muy graves) the illicit benefit obtained; Art. 49.2 factors include turnover and number of consumers affected; illicit benefit computed per Art. 49.3

authority: Competent consumer authorities (Art. 49.5 refers to Art. 21 of Regulation (EU) 2017/2394)
triggered_by: Sanctions under Art. 21 of Regulation (EU) 2017/2394 for very serious infringements
max_penalty_text: 4 % of the trader's annual business turnover in Spain or the affected Member States; if turnover information is not available, fines up to two million euros
quote: equivaldrá al 4 % del volumen de negocio anual del empresario en España o en los Estados miembros afectados por la infracción
penalty_formula: 4% of annual turnover (volumen de negocio anual) in Spain or affected Member States for very serious infringements; fallback maximum of 2,000,000 euros where turnover information is not available

authority: Administración pública competente (Art. 50)
triggered_by: Very serious infringements in consumer matters (Art. 48 classification)
max_penalty_text: Temporary closure of the establishment, installation or service for a maximum period of five years
quote: El cierre temporal del establecimiento, instalación o servicio por un plazo máximo de cinco años en los casos de infracciones muy graves.

authority: Administración pública competente (Art. 50)
triggered_by: Consumer-law infringements (accessory sanction)
max_penalty_text: Confiscation of goods owned by the responsible person, subject to proportionality and the exceptions stated; all confiscation costs borne by the infringer
quote: El comiso de las mercancías objeto de la infracción que sean propiedad del responsable

authority: Administración pública competente (Art. 50)
triggered_by: Final administrative sanctions for leves and graves infringements where there is risk to health or safety, recidivism or proven intent
max_penalty_text: Publication of the sanctions, the names of the responsible persons and the nature of the infringement
quote: La publicidad de las sanciones leves y graves impuestas, cuando hayan adquirido firmeza en vía administrativa

authority: Competent authority of the Administración (Art. 49.7)
triggered_by: Final resolutions ending sanction proceedings for very serious infringements and for sanctions under Art. 21 of Regulation (EU) 2017/2394
max_penalty_text: Publication on the website of the competent authority once notified, after handling confidential aspects and removing personal data, except the names of infringers
quote: serán de libre acceso y publicadas en la página web de la autoridad correspondiente

authority: Órgano competente para imponer la sanción (Art. 51.6)

max_penalty_text: Restoration of the altered situation to its original state and compensation for damage caused to the consumer, enforced after notice; unpaid amounts recovered under Art. 101 of Ley 39/2015
quote: podrá exigirse al infractor la reposición de la situación alterada por la infracción a su estado original

authority: Autoridad judicial or Ministerio Fiscal
triggered_by: Infringements of the consumer law that could constitute a crime
max_penalty_text: No criminal penalty is set out in this text; the competent body communicates the matter to the judicial authority or the Ministerio Fiscal
penalty_reference: Penal law not reproduced in this text
quote: En los supuestos en que las infracciones tipificadas en esta ley pudieran ser constitutivas de delito, el órgano competente comunicará tal extremo a la autoridad judicial o al Ministerio Fiscal.

triggered_by: Non-compliance with enforcement acts or orders after an execution request (requerimiento de ejecución)

cure_period: Compliance period set in the requirement notice
quote: las autoridades competentes podrán imponer multas coercitivas, una vez efectuado requerimiento de ejecución
penalty_formula: Coercive fines, reiterable for periods sufficient for compliance, independent of and compatible with sanctions; the period for compliance may not be shorter than the first requirement

penalty_reference: Texto refundido de la Ley de Propiedad Intelectual, arts. 138 et seq. (not reproduced in this text)
quote: será de aplicación, sin perjuicio de la responsabilidad penal en que en su caso incurra el prestador, el régimen de acciones y procedimientos establecido en los artículos 138 y siguientes

authority: Banco de España (Real Decreto-ley 19/2018, Disposición adicional cuarta, apartado 3.b)

quote: el Banco de España podrá imponer como medida accesoria una amonestación pública

quote: no se podrán ejercer los derechos políticos correspondientes a las participaciones adquiridas irregularmente

triggered_by: Unauthorised content that a content-sharing service provider keeps exploiting, causing significant harm to rights holders, even though the provider made best efforts to remove it (Art. 73.4, last paragraph)

quote: los titulares de derechos podrán ejercer las acciones legales dirigidas a reestablecer el daño patrimonial, tales como la acción de enriquecimiento injusto

authority: Órganos competentes por razón de la materia (Ley 37/2007, art. 11.6 as amended)
triggered_by: Infringements of the public sector information re-use law (Ley 37/2007)
max_penalty_text: No sanction types or amounts stated in this text; the amended art. 11.6 only governs how the sanctioning power is exercised
penalty_reference: Ley 37/2007, art. 11 (infringements and sanctions, not reproduced here); Ley 40/2015, Chapter III
quote: La potestad sancionadora se ejercerá, en todo lo no previsto en la presente ley, de conformidad con lo dispuesto en el Capítulo III de la Ley 40/2015

penalty_formula: not stated

triggered_by: Rejection of the prior authorisation for use of real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement, where use had commenced urgently without authorisation

penalty_formula: not stated

max_penalty_text: may also include warnings and non-monetary measures

triggered_by: Non-compliance with obligations of providers (Art. 16), authorised representatives (Art. 22), importers (Art. 23), distributors (Art. 24), deployers (Art. 26), notified bodies (Art. 31, Art. 33(1), (3), (4), Art. 34) or transparency obligations (Art. 50), other than Article 5

authority: Member States (national competent authorities or courts, as applicable under national law)
triggered_by: Supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to notified bodies or national competent authorities in reply to a request

quote: shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 7 500 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 1 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher
penalty_formula: up to EUR 7 500 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 1 % of total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher; for SMEs including start-ups, the lower of the two applies (Art. 99(6))

triggered_by: Non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5 by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies

quote: Non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5 shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 1 500 000.

penalty_formula: fixed maximum of EUR 750 000

triggered_by: Compliant high-risk AI system that nevertheless presents a risk to health, safety, fundamental rights or other public interest aspects

authority: National competent authority of establishment (or a judicial authority on its request)
triggered_by: Failure to comply with the Regulation, including investigative orders under Art. 26(1)
quote: the power to impose fines, or to request a judicial authority in their Member State to do so, for failure to comply with this Regulation
penalty_formula: Not stated; Member State penalty rules under Art. 24 apply

authority: National competent authority of establishment (or a judicial authority on its request)
triggered_by: Infringement of the Regulation by a cloud computing service provider
quote: the power to order the cessation of infringements and, where appropriate, to impose remedies proportionate to the infringement
penalty_formula: Cessation order and proportionate remedies

authority: National competent authority of establishment (or a judicial authority on its request)
triggered_by: Non-compliance with a cessation order or with investigative orders
quote: the power to impose a periodic penalty payment, or to request a judicial authority in their Member State to do so
penalty_formula: Periodic penalty payment; amount not stated

authority: Courts under Union and national law
triggered_by: Damage or loss suffered by recipients of cloud services due to a provider's infringement of Title IV Chapter I obligations
quote: Recipients of the cloud computing services shall have the right to seek, in accordance with Union and national law, compensation from cloud computing service provider s
penalty_formula: Compensation for damage or loss

authority: Evaluating national competent authority
triggered_by: Provider intentionally or negligently supplied incorrect or misleading information
quote: The evaluating national competent authority may revoke its rec ognition where it finds that a cloud computing service provider
penalty_formula: Revocation of Union-wide recognition at the assurance level; revocation published in the central repository for five years (Art. 22(3))

authority: Auditing organisation
triggered_by: Audited provider intentionally or negligently supplied incorrect or misleading audit evidence; or failed annual review
quote: The auditing organisation may revoke its audit report and audit opinion where the audited provider , i ntentionally or negligently , supplied incorrect or misleading audit evidence.
penalty_formula: Revocation of audit report and audit opinion

authority: European Commission
triggered_by: Strategic project no longer fulfils the criteria, or designation was based on incorrect information
quote: Projects for which the designation as a strategic project has been withdrawn shall lose all rights connected to that status under this Regulation.
penalty_formula: Withdrawal of designation; loss of all rights connected to strategic-project status

authority: European Commission
triggered_by: Undertaking, intentionally or through gross negligence, supplies incorrect, incomplete or misleading information in response to a Commission information request under Art. 25, or does not supply the information within the prescribed time limit
max_penalty_text: Fines shall not exceed EUR 300 000; where the undertaking is an SME, the fines shall not exceed EUR 50 000
cure_period: None stated. Art. 33(2) requires the Commission to hear the undertaking before a decision, and Art. 33(5) requires account to be taken of partial compliance where applicable.
quote: Fines imposed in the cases referred to in paragraph 1, point (a), shall not exceed EUR 300 000.
penalty_formula: Fixed ceiling of EUR 300 000. The SME ceiling of EUR 50 000 is stated in the same paragraph (Art. 33(3)). Amount set by Commission decision considering nature, gravity and duration (Art. 33(5)).

authority: European Commission
triggered_by: Undertaking, intentionally or through gross negligence, does not comply with the obligation to inform the Commission of a third-country obligation pursuant to Art. 25(7) and Art. 26(3)
max_penalty_text: Fines shall not exceed EUR 150 000; where the undertaking is an SME, the fines shall not exceed EUR 50 000
cure_period: None stated. Art. 33(2) requires the Commission to hear the undertaking before a decision.
quote: Fines imposed in the cases referred to in paragraph 1, point (b), shall not exceed EUR 150 000.
penalty_formula: Fixed ceiling of EUR 150 000. The SME ceiling of EUR 50 000 is stated in the same paragraph (Art. 33(3)).

authority: European Commission
triggered_by: Undertaking, intentionally or through gross negligence, does not comply with an obligation to prioritise the production of crisis-relevant products under Art. 26 (periodic penalty payments)
max_penalty_text: Periodic penalty payments shall not exceed 1,5 % of the current daily turnover for each working day of non-compliance; for an SME, 0,5 % of the current daily turnover
cure_period: None stated. Art. 33(6) allows the definitive amount to be set lower where the undertaking has fulfilled the requirements the penalty was intended to enforce.
quote: Periodic penalty payments imposed in the case referred to in paragraph 1, point (c), shall not exceed 1,5 % of the current daily turnover for each working day of non-compliance
penalty_formula: 1,5 % of current daily turnover per working day of non-compliance, counted from the date established in the decision issuing the priority-rated order; SME ceiling 0,5 % of current daily turnover. Commission may fix a lower definitive amount once the requirements are fulfilled (Art. 33(6)).

authority: Member States (competent authorities; penalties imposed in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2017/2394, Art. 21)
triggered_by: Penalties imposed in accordance with Article 21 of Regulation (EU) 2017/2394
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text; fines may be imposed through administrative procedures or through legal proceedings.
quote: they include the possibility either to impose fines through administrative procedures or to initiate legal proceedings for the imposition of fines, or both.

authority: Member States
triggered_by: Infringements of the national provisions adopted pursuant to this Directive
max_penalty_text: Not specified in this text; penalties must be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.
quote: The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

authority: Member States (national penalty rules under Art. 64(1); fines imposed by competent national authorities, courts or other bodies per Art. 64(8))
triggered_by: Non-compliance with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I and the obligations set out in Articles 13 and 14
max_penalty_text: Up to EUR 15 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 2.5% of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher
quote: shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 15 000 000
penalty_formula: If the offender is an undertaking: 2.5% of total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher (fixed EUR 15 000 000 cap otherwise applies)

authority: Member States (national penalty rules under Art. 64(1); fines imposed by competent national authorities, courts or other bodies per Art. 64(8))
triggered_by: Non-compliance with the obligations set out in Articles 18 to 23, 28, 30(1) to (4), 31(1) to (4), 32(1), (2) and (3), 33(5), and Articles 39, 41, 47, 49 and 53
max_penalty_text: Up to EUR 10 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 2% of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher
quote: shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 10 000 000
penalty_formula: If the offender is an undertaking: 2% of total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher. Art. 64(10): fines do not apply to microenterprises or small enterprises for failure to meet the deadline in Art. 14(2)(a) or 14(4)(a), nor to any infringement by open-source software stewards

authority: Member States (national penalty rules under Art. 64(1); fines imposed by competent national authorities, courts or other bodies per Art. 64(8))
triggered_by: Supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to notified bodies and market surveillance authorities in reply to a request
max_penalty_text: Up to EUR 5 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 1% of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher
quote: shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 5 000 000
penalty_formula: If the offender is an undertaking: 1% of total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher. Art. 64(10) exemptions as stated for Art. 64(3) apply to paragraphs 3 to 9

authority: Market surveillance authority of the Member State (Art. 54(1), (5)); notifying authorities act under Art. 54(7)-(8) for other Member States
triggered_by: Product with digital elements, including its vulnerability handling, presenting a significant cybersecurity risk and found non-compliant; the operator fails to take adequate corrective action (Art. 54(1), (5))
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text
cure_period: Operator must take corrective action within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk, as the authority may prescribe (Art. 54(1)); provisional measures follow if it fails to do so (Art. 54(5))
quote: shall take all appropriate provisional measures to prohibit or restrict that product with digital elements from being made available on its national market

authority: European Commission (Union-level corrective or restrictive measures)
triggered_by: Product with digital elements presenting a significant cybersecurity risk that remains non-compliant after the Article 56(1)-(4) procedure and no effective measures by market surveillance authorities
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text
cure_period: Withdrawal or recall within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk (Art. 56(5))
quote: the Commission may adopt implementing acts to provide for corrective or restrictive measures at Union level

authority: Market surveillance authority of the Member State (Art. 57(1)); European Commission for Union-level measures (Art. 57(9))
triggered_by: Product with digital elements that is compliant with this Regulation but, after evaluation, presents a significant cybersecurity risk as well as a risk to health or safety, fundamental-rights compliance, essential-entity services, or other public interest
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text
cure_period: Corrective action within the timeline established by the market surveillance authority (Art. 57(2))
quote: shall require an economic operator to take all appropriate measures

authority: Market surveillance authority of the Member State; Member State concerned (Art. 58(2))
triggered_by: Formal non-compliance findings under Art. 58(1) (e.g., CE marking, EU declaration of conformity or technical documentation deficiencies) where the manufacturer does not put an end to the non-compliance and it persists
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text
quote: shall take all appropriate measures to restrict or prohibit the product with digital elements from being made available on the market

authority: Market surveillance authority designated under Art. 52(2)-(3)
triggered_by: Finding that an open-source software steward does not comply with the obligations in Article 24
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text; Art. 64(10)(b) excludes administrative fines for infringements by open-source software stewards
quote: it shall require the open-source software steward to ensure that all appropriate corrective actions are taken

authority: Notified body (certificate restriction, suspension or withdrawal)
triggered_by: Product no longer complying after certification, or corrective measures required by the notified body not taken or not effective (Art. 47(5)-(6))
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text
cure_period: Manufacturer must take appropriate corrective measures required by the notified body before restriction, suspension or withdrawal (Art. 47(5)-(6))
quote: the notified body shall restrict, suspend or withdraw any certificates, as appropriate

authority: Notifying authority of the Member State
triggered_by: Notified body that no longer meets the requirements of Article 39 or is failing to fulfil its obligations
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text
quote: the notifying authority shall restrict, suspend or withdraw notification as appropriate

authority: Qualified entities bringing representative actions under Directive (EU) 2020/1828
triggered_by: Infringements by economic operators of provisions of this Regulation that harm, or may harm, the collective interests of consumers
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text
quote: Directive (EU) 2020/1828 shall apply to the representative actions brought against infringements

authority: Data holder, trade secret holder or user (requesting parties; no public authority named in this provision)
triggered_by: Circumstances in Art. 11(3), such as a third party or data recipient providing false information, using deceptive or coercive means, using data for unauthorised purposes, unlawfully disclosing data, or altering technical protection measures; Art. 11(5) extends the same rights to users where a data recipient infringes Art. 6(2)(a) or (b)
max_penalty_text: No monetary maximum stated. Requests to erase data and copies, to end production, offering, placing on the market or use of derivative goods or services (or their importation, export, storage or destruction), and to inform the user, without a fine amount
quote: to end the production, offering or placing on the market

authority: Party suffering from the misuse or disclosure of the unlawfully accessed or used data (requesting party; no public authority named)
triggered_by: Circumstances in Art. 11(3), including unlawful disclosure of data or use for unauthorised purposes; Art. 11(4) applies the same measures to users who alter technical protection measures or fail to maintain trade secret measures
max_penalty_text: No amount stated; compensation for the party suffering from the misuse or disclosure
quote: to compensate the party suffering from the misuse or disclosure of such unlawfully accessed or used data.

authority: Member States
triggered_by: infringements of this Regulation
max_penalty_text: not stated in this text; Member States lay down the rules on penalties
quote: Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties applicable to infringements of this Regulation and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are implemented

authority: supervisory authorities responsible for monitoring the application of Regulation (EU) 2016/679
triggered_by: infringements of the obligations laid down in Chapter II, III and V of this Regulation
max_penalty_text: up to the amount referred to in Article 83(5) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679
quote: may within their scope of competence impose administrative fines in accordance with Article 83 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679

authority: European Data Protection Supervisor
triggered_by: infringements of the obligations laid down in Chapter V of this Regulation
max_penalty_text: up to the amount referred to in Article 66(3) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1725
quote: the European Data Protection Supervisor may impose within its scope of competence administrative fines in accordance with Article 66 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1725

authority: competent authorities designated under Article 37(1)
triggered_by: alleged infringements of this Regulation, handled through complaints and investigations under Article 37(5)(b) and (c)
max_penalty_text: not stated in this text; financial penalties which may include periodic penalties and penalties with retroactive effect
quote: imposing effective, proportionate and dissuasive financial penalties which may include periodic penalties and penalties with retroactive effect
penalty_formula: may include periodic penalties and penalties with retroactive effect

authority: any competent authority of a Member State with competence under Article 37(13)
triggered_by: entity offering connected products or services in the Union that has not designated a legal representative under Article 37(11)
max_penalty_text: not stated in this text; effective, proportionate and dissuasive penalties
quote: Any competent authority may exercise its competence, including by imposing effective, proportionate and dissuasive penalties

authority: Member States (national penalty rules)
triggered_by: Infringements of the obligations regarding transfers of non-personal data to third countries under Art. 5(14) and Art. 31, the notification obligation under Art. 11, the conditions under Art. 12, and the registration conditions under Arts 18, 20, 21 and 22
max_penalty_text: No maximum stated in this Regulation; Member States lay down the penalty rules
quote: Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties applicable to infringements of the obligations regarding transfers of non-personal data to third countries

authority: Competent authority for data intermediation services
triggered_by: Finding under Art. 14(3) that a data intermediation services provider does not comply with the requirements of Chapter III
max_penalty_text: Dissuasive financial penalties, which may include periodic penalties and penalties with retroactive effect; no maximum amount stated
cure_period: Cessation within a reasonable time limit or immediately for serious infringements (Art. 14(4)); opportunity to state views within 30 days (Art. 14(3))
quote: to impose, through administrative procedures, dissuasive financial penalties, which may include periodic penalties and penalties with retroactive effect

authority: Competent authority for data intermediation services
triggered_by: Non-compliance with Chapter III found under Art. 14(3)
max_penalty_text: Postponement of commencement or suspension of the service until the requested changes are made
cure_period: Suspension lasts until the requested changes to the conditions have been made
quote: to require a postponement of the commencement or a suspension of the provision of the data intermediation service

authority: Competent authority for data intermediation services
triggered_by: Serious or repeated infringements not remedied despite prior notification under Art. 14(3); the provider is then to be removed from the register on Commission request
max_penalty_text: Cessation of the provision of the data intermediation service
cure_period: Infringements must not have been remedied despite prior notification
quote: to require the cessation of the provision of the data intermediation service in the event that serious or repeated infringements have not been remedied despite prior notification

authority: Competent authority for data intermediation services
triggered_by: Provider not established in the Union fails to designate a legal representative, or the legal representative fails to provide requested information (Art. 14(5))
max_penalty_text: Postponement of commencement or suspension of the service
cure_period: Suspension ends when the legal representative is designated or the necessary information is provided
quote: shall have the power to postpone the commencement of or to suspend the provision of the data intermediation service until the legal representative is designated or the necessary information is provided

authority: Competent authority for the registration of data altruism organisations
triggered_by: Recognised data altruism organisation does not comply with Chapter IV requirements even after notification under Art. 24(3)
max_penalty_text: Loss of the right to use the 'data altruism organisation recognised in the Union' label and removal from the national and Union registers
cure_period: Opportunity to state views within 30 days of notification (Art. 24(3)); no further cure period stated
quote: lose its right to use the label ‘data altruism organisation recognised in the Union’ in any written and spoken communication

authority: Competent authority for the registration of data altruism organisations
triggered_by: Infringement of Chapter IV requirements found under Art. 24(3)
max_penalty_text: Cessation of the infringement, either immediately or within a reasonable time limit
cure_period: Within a reasonable time limit, or immediately
quote: shall have the power to require the cessation of the infringement referred to in paragraph 3 either immediately or within a reasonable time limit

authority: AI Office
triggered_by: Infringement of any applicable provision of this Regulation, including those not listed in Art. 99(4); failure to comply with decisions or measures under Art. 14(4) or 16(3) of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 or Art. 75a; failure to comply with a commitment made binding under Art. 75b
max_penalty_text: Subject to administrative fines as referred to in Art. 99(4); the amount is not stated in this text
quote: In particular, the following shall be subject to administrative fines as referred to in Article 99(4):
penalty_formula: Amounts are set in Art. 99(4), which this text does not state. Art. 99(3) to (7) apply mutatis mutandis to AI Office penalties (Art. 75c(4)).

authority: AI Office
triggered_by: Supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to the AI Office in reply to a request
max_penalty_text: Subject to administrative fines as referred to in Art. 99(5); the amount is not stated in this text
quote: The supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to the AI Office in reply to a request shall be subject to administrative fines as referred to in Article 99(5).
penalty_formula: Amount is set in Art. 99(5), which this text does not state.

authority: AI Office
triggered_by: Failure to comply with the obligations listed in Art. 75c(5)(a) to (g), including submitting to an investigation or inspection, complying with an information request, corrective actions, binding commitments, or a decision under Art. 75c(1)
max_penalty_text: Periodic penalty payments shall not exceed 5 % of the average daily income or worldwide annual turnover in the preceding financial year per day, where applicable
quote: shall not exceed 5 % of the average daily income or worldwide annual turnover in the preceding financial year per day
penalty_formula: Up to 5 % of average daily income or worldwide annual turnover in the preceding financial year, per day, calculated from the date appointed by the decision

authority: Member States
triggered_by: Any infringement of this Regulation by operators; Member States' rules may include administrative fines, warnings and non-monetary measures
max_penalty_text: Member States lay down the penalty rules; no amount is stated in this text. For SMCs, each fine under Art. 99(4) and (5) is up to the percentages or amount referred to there, whichever is lower (Art. 99(6a))
quote: Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties and other enforcement measures, which may also include administrative fines, warnings and non-monetary measures
penalty_formula: For SMCs, each fine referred to in Art. 99(4) and (5) is up to the percentages or amount referred therein, whichever is lower (Art. 99(6a), inserted by Art. 1(38)(c)).

authority: Not stated specifically in this text for Art. 99(4) (Member State penalty rules under Art. 99(1))
triggered_by: Infringement of the obligations of providers and operators under Art. 25(2) and (4), added to the list in Art. 99(4)
max_penalty_text: Amount set in Art. 99(4); not stated in this text
quote: obligations of providers and operators pursuant to Article 25(2) and (4)
penalty_formula: Amount is set in Art. 99(4), which this text does not state; SMC cap per Art. 99(6a).

authority: AI Office (must notify the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned before deciding)
triggered_by: A decision that would have the effect of prohibiting or restricting an AI system being made available or put into service on a national market, or a decision to withdraw or recall the AI system from such market
max_penalty_text: No penalty amount; a market measure
quote: a decision to withdraw or recall the AI system from such market
penalty_formula: Not applicable (not a monetary sanction)

authority: AI Office
triggered_by: A decision establishing non-compliance by an operator under Art. 75c(1)
max_penalty_text: Corrective order to take the necessary measures within a reasonable period specified in the decision; no penalty amount
cure_period: A reasonable period specified in the decision (Art. 75c(3)); length not stated
quote: order the operator concerned to take the necessary measures to ensure compliance with the relevant provisions of this Regulation within a reasonable period specified therein
penalty_formula: Not applicable (corrective measure)

authority: AI Office
triggered_by: Instances of non-compliance with this Regulation by an operator under the AI Office's supervision and enforcement
max_penalty_text: Full reclaim of the costs of supervision and enforcement activities from the relevant operator; no amount stated
quote: The AI Office shall be authorised to fully reclaim from the relevant operator the totality of the costs of its supervision and enforcement activities with respect to instances of non-compliance
penalty_formula: Costs of supervision and enforcement activities, including human and technical resources (Art. 75a(1), referring to Art. 15 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020)

authority: Member State competent authorities for registration (Data Act Art. 32b)
triggered_by: Recognised data intermediation services provider or data altruism organisation not complying with Chapter VIIa requirements
cure_period: Opportunity to state views within 30 days of notification of findings; cessation immediately or within a reasonable time limit
quote: The competent authority shall have the power to require the cessation of the non-compliance referred to in paragraph 3 either immediately or within a reasonable time limit

authority: Member State competent authorities for registration; Commission (public Union register)
triggered_by: Continued non-compliance with Chapter VIIa after notification of findings
max_penalty_text: lose its right to use the label ... be removed from the public Union register
cure_period: Applies only if non-compliance continues after notification under Art. 32g(3)
quote: lose its right to use the label referred to in Article 32a in written and spoken communication; (b) be removed from the public Union register referred to in Article 32a

authority: Member States (penalties regime of the Data Act, not amended except the new paragraph 6)
triggered_by: Infringements of the Data Act as amended, except Chapter VIIc (re-use of public sector data), which is excluded from Art. 40
penalty_reference: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854, Article 40 (penalties); new Art. 40(6) excludes Chapter VIIc
quote: This Article shall not apply to Chapter VIIc.

authority: Public sector bodies granting re-use of certain categories of protected data
triggered_by: Results of re-use containing information that jeopardises the rights and interests of third parties
max_penalty_text: prohibit the use of results
quote: It shall also reserve the right to prohibit the use of results that contain information jeopardising the rights and interests of third parties.

authority: Competent authority of the Member State where the data holder is established (Data Act Art. 37)
triggered_by: Dispute over a public-emergency data request, its refusal or modification, compensation, or onward transmission
quote: the data holder, the public sector body, the Commission, the European Central Bank or the Union body may lodge a complaint with the competent authority

authority: European Commission (non-compliance decision; Court of Justice has unlimited jurisdiction to review, Art. 45)
triggered_by: Gatekeeper intentionally or negligently fails to comply with Arts 5, 6 or 7, specification measures under Art. 8(2), remedies under Art. 18(1), interim measures under Art. 24, or binding commitments under Art. 25
max_penalty_text: fines not exceeding 10 % of its total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year
quote: the Commission may impose on a gatekeeper fines not exceeding 10 % of its total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year
penalty_formula: Up to 10% of total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year; amount set by gravity, duration and recurrence (Art. 30(4))

authority: European Commission (non-compliance decision)
triggered_by: Same or similar infringement of Art. 5, 6 or 7 for the same core platform service as found in a non-compliance decision within the 8 preceding years
max_penalty_text: fines up to 20 % of its total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year
quote: the Commission may impose on a gatekeeper fines up to 20 % of its total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year
penalty_formula: Up to 20% of total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year for repeat infringements

authority: European Commission
triggered_by: Undertakings (incl. gatekeepers) or associations intentionally or negligently: failing to notify under Art. 3(3) or supply designation information; breaching Art. 14 concentration or Art. 15 audit information duties; failing to give access to data, algorithms or testing information or to answer requests (Art. 21), interviews (Art. 22) or inspections (Art. 23); breaching Art. 26 monitoring obligations; failing to introduce a compliance function (Art. 28); breaching file-access conditions (Art. 34(4))
max_penalty_text: fines not exceeding 1 % of their total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year
quote: fines not exceeding 1 % of their total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year
penalty_formula: Up to 1% of total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year; gravity, duration, recurrence and delay to proceedings considered (Art. 30(4)); for insolvent associations, each member's liability capped at 20% of its worldwide turnover (Art. 30(5))

authority: European Commission
triggered_by: Periodic penalty payments to compel compliance with Art. 8(2) measures, Art. 18(1) decisions, information requests and data/algorithm access (Art. 21), inspections (Art. 23), interim measures (Art. 24), commitments (Art. 25(1)) and non-compliance decisions (Art. 29(1))
max_penalty_text: not exceeding 5 % of the average daily worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year per day
quote: periodic penalty payments not exceeding 5 % of the average daily worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year per day
penalty_formula: Periodic penalty payment up to 5% of average daily worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year, per day from the date set by the decision; definitive amount may be reduced once the obligation is met (Art. 31(2))

authority: European Commission
triggered_by: Finding of non-compliance with Arts 5-7, Art. 8(2) measures, Art. 18(1) remedies, Art. 24 interim measures or Art. 25 commitments
quote: In the non-compliance decision, the Commission shall order the gatekeeper to cease and desist with the non-compliance within an appropriate deadline
penalty_formula: Cease-and-desist order with an appropriate deadline; gatekeeper must explain and describe its compliance measures (Art. 29(5)-(6))

authority: European Commission (implementing act after market investigation)
triggered_by: Systematic non-compliance: systematic infringement of Arts 5, 6 or 7 that maintained, strengthened or extended the gatekeeper position (deemed after 3 non-compliance decisions in 8 years, Art. 18(3))
quote: the Commission may adopt an implementing act imposing on such gatekeeper any behavioural or structural remedies which are proportionate and necessary to ensure effective compliance with this Regulation
penalty_formula: Behavioural or structural remedies, which may include a prohibition, during a limited period, on concentrations regarding the affected services

authority: European Commission (implementing act)
triggered_by: Urgency due to risk of serious and irreparable damage to business or end users, on a prima facie finding of infringement of Art. 5, 6 or 7, within non-compliance proceedings
quote: the Commission may adopt an implementing act ordering interim measures against a gatekeeper on the basis of a prima facie finding of an infringement of Article 5, 6 or 7
penalty_formula: Interim measures for a specified, renewable period

authority: National courts; representative actions by qualified entities under Directive (EU) 2020/1828
triggered_by: Infringements by gatekeepers of the Regulation that harm or may harm the collective interests of consumers
penalty_reference: Directive (EU) 2020/1828 (representative actions), as amended by Art. 52
quote: Directive (EU) 2020/1828 shall apply to the representative actions brought against infringements by gatekeepers of provisions of this Regulation that harm or may harm the collective interests of consumers.
penalty_formula: Remedies as provided in Directive (EU) 2020/1828; applies from 25 June 2023

authority: Lead Overseer (ESAs, through the Joint Committee)
triggered_by: Whole or partial non-compliance with measures required under Article 35(1), points (a), (b) and (c), after at least 30 calendar days from notification of those measures; imposed daily until compliance, for no more than six months
max_penalty_text: up to 1 % of the average daily worldwide turnover of the critical ICT third-party service provider in the preceding business year
penalty_reference: Art. 35(6)-(9); cross-referenced in Art. 37(3)(e), Art. 38(3), Art. 38(4), Art. 39(2) and Art. 39(6)
cure_period: Decision may be taken only after at least 30 calendar days from notification of the measures; daily payments cease on compliance
quote: up to 1 % of the average daily worldwide turnover of the critical ICT third-party service provider in the preceding business year
penalty_formula: Up to 1% of average daily worldwide turnover in the preceding business year, calculated from the date stated in the decision; imposed on a daily basis until compliance

authority: Competent authorities
triggered_by: Risks identified in recommendations addressed to a critical ICT third-party service provider not being addressed; applied as a measure of last resort after notification and, if appropriate, consultation under Art. 42(4) and (5)
max_penalty_text: No monetary maximum stated; temporary suspension of the use or deployment of the provider's service, in part or completely, until the identified risks are addressed
cure_period: Competent authorities shall grant financial entities the necessary period of time to adjust contractual arrangements before the suspension takes effect
quote: take a decision requiring financial entities to temporarily suspend, either in part or completely, the use or deployment of a service provided by the critical ICT third-party service provider

authority: Member States (competent authorities apply the penalties and remedial measures)
triggered_by: Breaches of this Regulation; also applicable to members of the management body and other responsible individuals under Art. 50(5)
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this Regulation; Member States lay down administrative penalties and remedial measures that are effective, proportionate and dissuasive
penalty_reference: Art. 50(3), Art. 50(4)(c), Art. 50(5); factors listed in Art. 51(2); appeal right under Art. 50(6)
quote: Member States shall lay down rules establishing appropriate administrative penalties and remedial measures for breaches of this Regulation

authority: Competent authorities
triggered_by: Conduct in breach of this Regulation

authority: Independent recourse mechanisms or applicable law (as the text provides)

quote: any misrepresentation about an organization’s participation in or compliance with the EU-U.S. DPF may be subject to enforcement action by the FTC, the DOT, or other relevant government body

authority: Member States' penalty rules, applied by Digital Services Coordinators (Art. 51(2)(c))
triggered_by: Failure to comply with an obligation laid down in the Regulation by providers of intermediary services within a Member State's competence

penalty_formula: Maximum fine: 6 % of annual worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year

authority: Member States' penalty rules, applied by Digital Services Coordinators (Art. 51(2)(c))
triggered_by: Supplying incorrect, incomplete or misleading information, failing to reply or rectify such information, or failing to submit to an inspection

triggered_by: Failure to terminate an infringement in compliance with a cessation order, or failure to comply with investigative orders

authority: Digital Services Coordinators (Art. 51(2)(b)), or a judicial authority on request

penalty_formula: Not applicable (non-monetary order)

penalty_formula: Restriction for four weeks, extendable in periods of the same length subject to a maximum number of extensions set by the judicial authority

quote: fines not exceeding 6 % of its total worldwide annual turnover in the preceding financial year
penalty_formula: Maximum fine: 6 % of total worldwide annual turnover in the preceding financial year

authority: European Commission
triggered_by: Supplying incorrect, incomplete or misleading information, failing to reply to a request for information by decision, refusing an inspection, or failing to comply with monitoring measures or file access conditions, intentionally or negligently

penalty_formula: Maximum fine: 1 % of total annual income or worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year

triggered_by: Failure to comply with a Commission decision: supplying correct information, submitting to an inspection, complying with interim measures, commitments or a non-compliance decision, including action plan requirements

penalty_formula: Not stated in this text

triggered_by: non-compliance by a health data user with the requirements of Chapter IV (Art. 63(3))

cure_period: Art. 63(2): opportunity to state views within a reasonable period not exceeding four weeks; no cure period stated

cure_period: Art. 63(2): opportunity to state views within a reasonable period not exceeding four weeks; no cure period stated

quote: 排除措置命令に違反した者は、五十万円以下の過料に処する。
penalty_formula: Not applicable. Excluded where the act is punishable criminally (proviso of Art. 56)

authority: Not stated in the provision
triggered_by: Violation of the court's temporary suspension order under Art. 40 para. 1
max_penalty_text: Non-criminal fine (過料) of up to JPY 300,000
quote: 第四十条第一項の規定による裁判に違反した者は、三十万円以下の過料に処する。
penalty_formula: Not applicable

authority: 裁判所 (court), in the criminal judgment for an Art. 50 offence
triggered_by: Conviction under Art. 50; cancellation or ban applies only where the patent or licence belongs to the offender
max_penalty_text: Cancellation of the patent or patent licence used for the violation, and ban on contracts with the government for 6 months to 3 years after the judgment becomes final
penalty_reference: Art. 58 para. 1 item 1; Art. 58 para. 1 item 2
provision: Art. 58 para. 1 item 1 (第五十八条第一項第一号)
quote: 違反行為に供せられた特許権の特許又は特許発明の専用実施権若しくは通常実施権は取り消されるべき旨
penalty_formula: Discretionary (情状により) at the court's discretion, together with the sentence. On a final judgment the court sends a copy to the Commissioner-General of the Patent Office (Art. 58 para. 2 and para. 3)

authority: Court (on conviction)
triggered_by: Offence under this Act for which no specific penalty is provided, or any other contravention of this Act (e.g., ss. 19(3), 19(7), 30(3), 57(3), 72)
max_penalty_text: a fine not exceeding three million shillings or to an imprisonment term not exceeding ten years, or to both
quote: a fine not exceeding three million shillings or to an imprisonment term not exceeding ten years, or to both
penalty_formula: none stated

authority: Court (on conviction)
triggered_by: Failure, without reasonable excuse, to comply with an enforcement notice

quote: commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding five million shillings or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years, or to both.
penalty_formula: none stated

authority: Court (on conviction)
triggered_by: Obstructing, impeding or failing to assist the Data Commissioner in exercising a power under s. 9, or giving false or misleading information to the Data Commissioner
max_penalty_text: a fine not exceeding five million shillings or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years, or to both
quote: commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding five million shillings or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years, or to both.
penalty_formula: none stated

authority: Data Commissioner (penalty notice)
triggered_by: Failure or continuing failure of a person as described in s. 58 (non-compliance with a provision of the Act), with the amount set in a penalty notice
max_penalty_text: up to five million shillings, or in the case of an undertaking, up to one per centum of its annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is lower
cure_period: not stated; the penalty notice must specify an amount and the Commissioner must have regard to mitigation and cooperation (s. 62(2))
quote: up to five million shillings, or in the case of an undertaking, up to one per centum of its annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is lower
penalty_formula: For an undertaking: up to one per centum of its annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is lower (compared with five million shillings)

authority: Data Commissioner (enforcement notice)
triggered_by: Commissioner satisfied that a person has failed, or is failing, to comply with any provision of the Act
max_penalty_text: not stated (non-compliance with the notice is an offence under s. 58(3))
cure_period: Period specified in the notice, not less than twenty-one days
quote: the Data Commissioner may serve an enforcement notice on that person requiring that person to take such steps and within such period as may be specified in the notice
penalty_formula: none stated

authority: Data Commissioner
triggered_by: Information given by the applicant is false or misleading, or the registration certificate holder, without lawful excuse, fails to comply with any requirement of the Act
max_penalty_text: not stated
cure_period: no cure period stated; a notice to show cause must be issued before variation or cancellation
quote: may, on issuance of a notice to show cause, vary terms and conditions of the certificate of registration or cancel the registration where
penalty_formula: none stated

authority: Data Commissioner
triggered_by: Transfer of personal data out of Kenya, exercised to protect the rights and fundamental freedoms of data subjects
max_penalty_text: not stated
quote: may, in order to protect the rights and fundamental freedoms of data subjects, prohibit, suspend or subject the transfer to such conditions as may be determined
penalty_formula: none stated

authority: Court
triggered_by: Commission of an offence under this Act (forfeiture of equipment or articles used or connected with the offence)
max_penalty_text: not stated
