penalty_formula: none stated

authority: Court
triggered_by: Continuing contravention of this Act
max_penalty_text: not stated
quote: order or prohibit the doing of any act to stop a continuing contravention
penalty_formula: none stated

authority: Not specified in the text (claim against the data controller or data processor)
triggered_by: Damage suffered by a person by reason of a contravention of a requirement of this Act
max_penalty_text: not stated; compensation for damage, including financial loss and distress (s. 65(4))
quote: A person who suffers damage by reason of a contravention of a requirement of this Act is entitled to compensation for that damage from the data controller or the data processor.
penalty_formula: none stated

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Processing violations listed in Art. 64-2(1) items 1-9, including Art. 15(1), 17(1), 18(1)-(2), 19, 22-2(1), 23(1) item 1, 24(1), 24-2(1), 26(4), 28-5(1), 28-8(1), 28-9(1) and failure to take safeguards before a leak (item 9)
max_penalty_text: Surcharge not exceeding 3% of total revenue; where there is no revenue or it is difficult to calculate, not exceeding 2 billion won (20억원)
cure_period: No cure period stated; Art. 64-2(7) lists grounds for not imposing a surcharge
quote: 전체 매출액의 100분의 3을 초과하지 아니하는 범위에서 과징금을 부과할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Up to 3% of total revenue (Art. 64-2(1)); revenue unrelated to the violation is excluded (Art. 64-2(3)); no-revenue cap 2,000,000,000 won

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Repeat violation within three years of a prior surcharge (Art. 64-2(2) item 1); intentional or grossly negligent violation affecting 10 million or more data subjects (item 2); failure to comply with a corrective order under Art. 64(1) causing a leak (item 3)
max_penalty_text: Surcharge not exceeding 10% of total revenue; where there is no revenue or it is difficult to calculate, not exceeding 5 billion won (50억원)
quote: 전체 매출액의 100분의 10을 초과하지 아니하는 범위에서 과징금을 부과할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Up to 10% of total revenue (Art. 64-2(2)); revenue unrelated to the violation is excluded (Art. 64-2(3)); no-revenue cap 5,000,000,000 won

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Any violation of the Act by a person other than central government bodies, local governments, the National Assembly, courts, the Constitutional Court and the National Election Commission
max_penalty_text: No monetary amount; orders to stop infringing conduct, temporarily suspend processing, or take other necessary measures
penalty_reference: Non-compliance: Art. 75(1) item 27 (fine) and Art. 64-2(2) item 3 (surcharge)
quote: 이 법을 위반한 자(중앙행정기관, 지방자치단체, 국회, 법원, 헌법재판소, 중앙선거관리위원회는 제외한다)에 대하여 다음 각 호에 해당하는 조치를 명할 수 있다.
penalty_formula: Not applicable (non-monetary order)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Continuing or anticipated cross-border transfer in violation of Art. 28-8(1), (4) or (5), or where the recipient or destination does not protect personal information adequately and data subjects are or are likely to be harmed
max_penalty_text: No monetary amount; order to stop the cross-border transfer
cure_period: Objection may be lodged within 7 days of receiving the order (Art. 28-9(2))
quote: 개인정보의 국외 이전을 중지할 것을 명할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Not applicable (non-monetary order)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Surcharges, corrective orders, improvement recommendations, referrals, disciplinary recommendations or fines under Arts. 61, 64, 64-2, 65 and 75
max_penalty_text: Public disclosure of the outcome, which the commission may be ordered to make on the affected party
quote: 해당 처분 등을 받았다는 사실을 공표할 것을 명할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Not applicable (publicity sanction)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Reasonable grounds to believe a violation of personal information law occurred; the responsible person (including representatives and responsible officers) is the target
max_penalty_text: Recommendation to the processing entity to discipline the responsible person; no monetary amount
quote: 책임이 있는 자(대표자 및 책임있는 임원을 포함한다)를 징계할 것을 해당 개인정보처리자에게 권고할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Not applicable (disciplinary recommendation)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Reasonable grounds to believe a criminal violation of personal information law occurred
max_penalty_text: Referral to the competent investigative authority; no monetary amount in this provision
quote: 관할 수사기관에 그 내용을 고발할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Not applicable (referral)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Violation of the Act found in a preliminary inspection under Art. 63-2(1)
max_penalty_text: Corrective recommendation; no monetary amount; the processor must notify acceptance within 10 days (Art. 63-2(3))
cure_period: 10 days from notice to state whether the recommendation is accepted (Art. 63-2(3))
quote: 해당 개인정보처리자에 대하여 시정방안을 정하여 이에 따를 것을 권고할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Not applicable (recommendation); acceptance is treated as acceptance of a corrective order under Art. 64(1) (Art. 63-2(4))

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Certification obtained by fraud (item 1, revocation mandatory); refusal or obstruction of follow-up management (item 2); falling below the certification standard (item 3); serious violation of personal information laws (item 4)
max_penalty_text: Revocation of personal information protection certification; no monetary amount
quote: 보호위원회는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 제1항에 따른 인증을 취소할 수 있다.
penalty_formula: Not applicable (certification revocation)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Designated impact assessment body that obtained designation by fraud, voluntarily withdraws or closes, fails designation requirements, or performs its work negligently or intentionally; other grounds set by decree
max_penalty_text: Revocation of designation as an impact assessment body; no monetary amount
quote: 보호위원회는 제2항에 따라 지정된 평가기관이 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 평가기관의 지정을 취소할 수 있다.
penalty_formula: Not applicable (designation revocation); a hearing is required before revocation (Art. 33(8))

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission) and relevant central administrative agency heads
triggered_by: Designated data management specialist agency that obtained designation by fraud or other improper means (mandatory revocation) or no longer meets designation requirements
max_penalty_text: Revocation of designation as a personal information management specialist agency; no monetary amount
quote: 개인정보관리 전문기관의 지정을 취소할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Not applicable (designation revocation); a hearing is required before revocation (Art. 35-3(5))

authority: Not stated in this provision (applies to offenders under Arts. 70-73)
triggered_by: Offence under Arts. 70-73 by which the offender obtained money, goods or other benefits in connection with the violation
max_penalty_text: Confiscation of the benefits obtained; if confiscation is not possible, collection of their value
quote: 해당 위반행위와 관련하여 취득한 금품이나 그 밖의 이익은 몰수할 수 있으며
penalty_formula: Value of the benefit obtained (confiscation or collection of value as substitute)

authority: Criminal courts (sentencing); the text does not name the authority
triggered_by: Obstructing public agency personal information processing by altering or deleting data with the aim of causing serious disruption (item 1); obtaining another person's personal information by deception and providing it to a third party for profit or improper purposes (item 2)
max_penalty_text: Imprisonment for up to 10 years or a fine of up to 100 million won (1억원)
quote: 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자는 10년 이하의 징역 또는 1억원 이하의 벌금에 처한다.
penalty_formula: Imprisonment up to 10 years or fine up to 100,000,000 won

authority: Criminal courts (sentencing); the text does not name the authority
triggered_by: Violations listed in Art. 71 items 1-10, including providing personal data to third parties without consent, using or providing data in breach of Arts. 18, 19, 26(5) or 28-2, processing children's or sensitive data without the required basis, and breaching Art. 59 item 2 or 3
max_penalty_text: Imprisonment for up to 5 years or a fine of up to 50 million won (5천만원)
quote: 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자는 5년 이하의 징역 또는 5천만원 이하의 벌금에 처한다.
penalty_formula: Imprisonment up to 5 years or fine up to 50,000,000 won

authority: Criminal courts (sentencing); the text does not name the authority
triggered_by: Misuse of CCTV or mobile video devices outside their purpose or recording audio (item 1); obtaining personal information by deception and providing it or consenting by deception (item 2); breach of professional secrecy by persons performing listed duties (item 3)
max_penalty_text: Imprisonment for up to 3 years or a fine of up to 30 million won (3천만원)
quote: 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자는 3년 이하의 징역 또는 3천만원 이하의 벌금에 처한다.
penalty_formula: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine up to 30,000,000 won

authority: Criminal courts (sentencing); the text does not name the authority
triggered_by: Continued use or provision of data after failing to correct or delete it on request (Art. 36(2)) or after failing to suspend processing on request (Art. 37(2)); violating a nondisclosure order under Art. 39-4; refusing or falsifying data submission or inspection in order to conceal violations (Art. 63(1) and (2))
max_penalty_text: Imprisonment for up to 2 years or a fine of up to 20 million won (2천만원)
quote: 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자는 2년 이하의 징역 또는 2천만원 이하의 벌금에 처한다.
penalty_formula: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine up to 20,000,000 won; prosecution for item 3 requires a complaint by the applicant for the nondisclosure order (Art. 73(2))

authority: Criminal courts (sentencing); the text does not name the authority
triggered_by: Offence under Art. 70 committed by a representative, agent, employee or other staff member in connection with the business of a corporation or individual, unless due care and supervision were exercised
max_penalty_text: In addition to punishing the actor, a fine of up to 70 million won (7천만원) on the corporation or individual
quote: 그 행위자를 벌하는 외에 그 법인 또는 개인을 7천만원 이하의 벌금에 처한다.
penalty_formula: Fine up to 70,000,000 won on the entity (Art. 74(1)); for offences under Arts. 71-73, the entity is fined the same as the article provides (Art. 74(2))

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission) imposes and collects (Art. 75(5))
triggered_by: Installing or operating fixed video devices in public places without a permitted basis (Art. 75(1) item 1, Art. 25(2)); recording persons with mobile video devices in breach of Art. 25-2(2) (item 2)
max_penalty_text: Fine not exceeding 50 million won (5천만원)
quote: 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자에게는 5천만원 이하의 과태료를 부과한다.
penalty_formula: Administrative fine up to 50,000,000 won; the commission may reduce or waive it in light of the violation and the operator's size (Art. 75(5))

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission) imposes and collects (Art. 75(5))
triggered_by: Violations listed in Art. 75(2) items 1-27, including refusing to provide goods or services for declining optional consent (item 1), failing to notify under Art. 20(1)-(2) (item 2), failing to take required destruction or safeguard measures (items 4-5), failing to publish a privacy policy only where applicable, failing to notify impact or leak information (items 17-18), and failing to comply with a corrective order under Art. 64(1) (item 27)
max_penalty_text: Fine not exceeding 30 million won (3천만원)
quote: 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자에게는 3천만원 이하의 과태료를 부과한다.
penalty_formula: Administrative fine up to 30,000,000 won (Art. 75(5) allows reduction or waiver)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission) imposes and collects (Art. 75(5))
triggered_by: Subcontracting processing to a third party without the principal's consent (Art. 75(3) item 1); designating a domestic agent in breach of Art. 31-2(2) (item 3); failing to supervise a domestic agent (item 4)
max_penalty_text: Fine not exceeding 20 million won (2천만원)
quote: 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자에게는 2천만원 이하의 과태료를 부과한다.
penalty_formula: Administrative fine up to 20,000,000 won (Art. 75(5) allows reduction or waiver)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission) imposes and collects (Art. 75(5))
triggered_by: Violations listed in Art. 75(4) items 1-12, including failing to supply documents to the commission (item 1), failing to separately store data (item 2), obtaining consent in breach of Art. 22(1)-(3) (item 3), failing to include required contract terms in outsourcing (item 4), and failing to disclose outsourcing details (item 5)
max_penalty_text: Fine not exceeding 10 million won (1천만원)
quote: 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자에게는 1천만원 이하의 과태료를 부과한다.
penalty_formula: Administrative fine up to 10,000,000 won (Art. 75(5) allows reduction or waiver)

authority: 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission, Art. 7)
triggered_by: Late payment of a surcharge imposed under Art. 64-2(1) or (2)
max_penalty_text: Late-payment surcharge of 6% per year on the unpaid surcharge, collected for up to 60 months
cure_period: Demand notice with a set period before collection (Art. 64-2(10))
quote: 납부기한의 다음 날부터 내지 아니한 과징금의 연 100분의 6에 해당하는 가산금을 징수한다
penalty_formula: 6% per year on the unpaid surcharge from the day after the payment deadline; collection period not exceeding 60 months (Art. 64-2(9)); unpaid amounts may be collected as national tax (Art. 64-2(10))

authority: Courts (civil damages action by the data subject)
triggered_by: Data subject harmed by a violation of this Act by a personal information processor
max_penalty_text: Actual damages; the processor must prove absence of intent or negligence to avoid liability
quote: 정보주체는 개인정보처리자가 이 법을 위반한 행위로 손해를 입으면 개인정보처리자에게 손해배상을 청구할 수 있다.
penalty_formula: Actual damages; liability is presumed unless the processor proves no intent or negligence

authority: Courts (civil damages action by the data subject)
triggered_by: Leak of personal information caused by the processor's intent or gross negligence, where the data subject suffered damage
max_penalty_text: Court may set damages up to five times the amount of the damage; the processor may avoid this by proving no intent or gross negligence
quote: 법원은 그 손해액의 5배를 넘지 아니하는 범위에서 손해배상액을 정할 수 있다.
penalty_formula: Up to 5 times the damage amount (punitive); factors in Art. 39(4) apply

authority: Courts (civil damages action by the data subject)
triggered_by: Leak of personal information caused by the processor's intent or negligence; the data subject may claim without proving the amount of damage
max_penalty_text: Statutory damages up to 3 million won (300만원) on the court's assessment of a reasonable amount
quote: 300만원 이하의 범위에서 상당한 금액을 손해액으로 하여 배상을 청구할 수 있다
penalty_formula: Reasonable amount up to 3,000,000 won as statutory damages; the processor may avoid liability by proving no intent or negligence

authority: Courts (collective action by qualifying organisations)
triggered_by: Processor refuses collective mediation under Art. 49 or does not accept its result (Art. 51); qualifying consumer or non-profit organisations may sue
max_penalty_text: Court order prohibiting or stopping the infringing conduct; no monetary amount
quote: 법원에 권리침해 행위의 금지ㆍ중지를 구하는 소송
penalty_formula: Not applicable (injunction); preliminary measures may be ordered under the Civil Execution Act (Art. 57(2))

authority: 방송미디어통신위원회 (Korea Media and Communications Commission)
triggered_by: Violation of Art. 50(1) prohibited conduct, including app market operators under Art. 50(1)(9)-(11)
max_penalty_text: Corrective measures listed in Art. 52(1); no monetary maximum stated
penalty_reference: 제52조제1항; 제52조제2항 (compliance period set by Presidential Decree)
cure_period: Compliance period set by Presidential Decree; may be extended once for force majeure (제52조제2항)
quote: 방송미디어통신위원회는 제50조제1항을 위반한 행위가 있다고 인정하면 전기통신사업자에게 다음 각 호의 조치를 명할 수 있다.

authority: 과학기술정보통신부장관 (Ministry of Science and ICT)
triggered_by: Failure to comply with a corrective order under Art. 52(1) within the period set in the order
max_penalty_text: 매출액의 1천분의 3 이내의 범위에서 하루당 금액 (up to 0.3% of revenue per day)
cure_period: Period set in the corrective order; charges stop once the order is complied with (제52조의2제5항)
quote: 매출액의 1천분의 3 이내의 범위에서 하루당 금액을 정하여 이행강제금을 부과할 수 있다.
penalty_formula: Up to 0.3% of revenue (1천분의 3) per day; repeated every 90 days from the first order until compliance (제52조의2제4항)

authority: 방송미디어통신위원회 (Korea Media and Communications Commission)
triggered_by: Violation of Art. 50(1) prohibited conduct
max_penalty_text: 대통령령으로 정하는 매출액의 100분의 3 이하에 해당하는 금액 (up to 3% of revenue as defined by decree)
quote: 대통령령으로 정하는 매출액의 100분의 3 이하에 해당하는 금액을 과징금으로 부과할 수 있다
penalty_formula: 3% of revenue as defined by Presidential Decree; where revenue is absent or hard to calculate, up to KRW 1 billion (10억원); revenue may be estimated from comparable operators if data are refused

authority: 과학기술정보통신부장관 (Ministry of Science and ICT)

quote: De ocho mil hasta veintidós mil veces el valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización en los casos previstos en las fracciones I, II, III, IV, XI, XII, XIII y XIV del artículo anterior
penalty_formula: Range of 8,000 to 22,000 UMA daily values (Art. 229 I-IV, XI-XIV) or 1,500 to 8,000 UMA daily values (other cases); additional fine of up to 700 UMA daily values for persisting in the infraction; sanctions are additional to damages under Arts. 213 and 216 Bis and without prejudice to criminal sanctions
currency: UMA (valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización)

authority: Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial (IMPI), under Art. 234
triggered_by: Infracciones en materia de comercio under Art. 231 (conduct carried out for direct or indirect profit), including unauthorized communication, reproduction, distribution and sale of protected works
max_penalty_text: 5,000 to 40,000 days of minimum wage for Art. 231 I-V, VII-IX; 1,000 to 5,000 days for Art. 231 VI; 500 to 1,000 days for Art. 231 X; additional fine of up to 500 days of general minimum wage per day for persistence
quote: De cinco mil hasta cuarenta mil días de salario mínimo en los casos previstos en las fracciones I, II, III, IV, V, VII, VIII y IX del artículo anterior
penalty_formula: Range of 5,000 to 40,000 days of minimum wage (Art. 231 I-V, VII-IX), 1,000 to 5,000 days (Art. 231 VI), or 500 to 1,000 days (Art. 231 X); additional fine up to 500 days of general minimum wage per day for persistence; Art. 233 allows an increase of up to 50 percent where the infringer is a publisher, broadcaster or person exploiting works commercially

authority: Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial (IMPI), under Art. 232 Sexies referring to Art. 234
triggered_by: Producing, distributing, importing, offering, or otherwise making available devices, products or services that are promoted for, mainly used for, or designed to circumvent an effective technological protection measure (Art. 232 Bis I-III)
max_penalty_text: 1,000 to 20,000 times the daily UMA value
quote: Se impondrá multa de mil hasta veinte mil veces el valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
penalty_formula: Fine of 1,000 to 20,000 UMA daily values; infractions sanctioned under Art. 234 and with the Ley Federal de Procedimiento Administrativo
currency: UMA (valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización)

authority: Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial (IMPI), under Art. 232 Sexies referring to Art. 234
triggered_by: Circumventing an effective technological protection measure that controls access to a work, performance or phonogram
max_penalty_text: 1,000 to 10,000 times the daily UMA value
quote: Se impondrá multa de mil hasta diez mil veces el valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización, a quien eluda una medida tecnológica de protección efectiva
penalty_formula: Fine of 1,000 to 10,000 UMA daily values; sanctioned under Art. 234 and with the Ley Federal de Procedimiento Administrativo
currency: UMA (valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización)

authority: Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial (IMPI), under Art. 232 Sexies referring to Art. 234
triggered_by: Unauthorized removal or alteration of rights management information, or distribution or communication of copies knowing that such information was removed or altered (Art. 232 Quáter I-III)
max_penalty_text: 1,000 to 20,000 times the daily UMA value
quote: Se impondrá una multa de mil hasta veinte mil veces el valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización, a quien sin la autorización respectiva
penalty_formula: Fine of 1,000 to 20,000 UMA daily values; sanctioned under Art. 234 and with the Ley Federal de Procedimiento Administrativo
currency: UMA (valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización)

authority: Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial (IMPI), under Art. 232 Sexies referring to Art. 234
triggered_by: A false declaration in a notice or counter-notice affecting another party (I); an online service provider failing expeditiously to remove or disable access after a notice or competent authority order (II); an internet service provider failing to provide infringer identification information on request (III)
max_penalty_text: 1,000 to 20,000 times the daily UMA value
quote: Se impondrá una multa de mil hasta veinte mil veces el valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
penalty_formula: Fine of 1,000 to 20,000 UMA daily values for each of the three cases; sanctioned under Art. 234 and with the Ley Federal de Procedimiento Administrativo; without prejudice to Art. 114 Octies
currency: UMA (valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización)

authority: Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial (IMPI)
triggered_by: Commercial-matter infractions under Art. 231 and 232
penalty_reference: Ley de la Propiedad Industrial, Títulos Sexto y Séptimo (procedure referenced in Art. 234)
quote: El Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial podrá adoptar las medidas precautorias previstas en la Ley de Propiedad Industrial.
penalty_formula: Precautionary measures as provided in the Ley de la Propiedad Industrial; the IMPI may also carry out investigations, inspection visits and information requests

authority: Tribunales Federales, and the Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial for commercial-matter infractions
triggered_by: Commercial-matter infractions; foreign-origin goods at the border
quote: quedan facultados para emitir una resolución de suspensión de la libre circulación de mercancías de procedencia extranjera en frontera
penalty_formula: Suspension of the free circulation of foreign-origin goods at the border, under the terms of the Ley Aduanera

authority: Instituto Nacional del Derecho de Autor (INDAUTOR)
triggered_by: Non-compliance with the obligations the Law sets for collective management societies, or a conflict among members that leaves the society without leadership so that its purpose is affected
cure_period: A prior warning (apercibimiento) from the Institute, setting a period of no more than three months to remedy or correct the facts, must precede revocation
quote: La autorización podrá ser revocada por el Instituto si existiese incumplimiento de las obligaciones que esta Ley establece para las sociedades de gestión colectiva

authority: Instituto Nacional del Derecho de Autor (INDAUTOR)
triggered_by: Violation of copyright and related rights, to prevent or end the violation
quote: Ordenar y ejecutar los actos provisionales para prevenir o terminar con la violación al derecho de autor y derechos conexos
penalty_formula: Provisional acts ordered and executed by the Institute

authority: Federal courts, and state or Mexico City courts, on request of rights holders
triggered_by: Threatened or actual violation of the patrimonial rights in Art. 27, to prevent, impede or avoid the violation
cure_period: No cure period stated; the rights holder must give written notice to the alleged infringer at least 72 hours before filing the judicial request
quote: podrán solicitar a los Tribunales Federales y/o Tribunales de los Estados y/o de la Ciudad de México, el otorgamiento y ejecución de las siguientes
penalty_formula: Measures include suspension of public performance, communication or execution; attachment of entry receipts or income; precautionary seizure of instruments, equipment or supplies; and, where the other measures are insufficient, attachment of the commercial business. Sufficient guarantee for possible damages required under the Reglamento; measures lapse on compliance

authority: Tribunales de la Federación
triggered_by: Copyright-related offences
max_penalty_text: Not stated in this text; penalties are those of the cited Code
penalty_reference: Título Vigésimo Sexto del Código Penal Federal
quote: Corresponde conocer a los Tribunales de la Federación de los delitos relacionados con el derecho de autor previstos en el Título Vigésimo Sexto del Código Penal Federal.

authority: Judicial authorities (judge, with expert hearing where damages cannot be determined under the minimum rule)
triggered_by: Violation of the rights conferred by the Law
max_penalty_text: Minimum of 40 percent of the retail price of the original product or service; no maximum stated
quote: en ningún caso será inferior al cuarenta por ciento del precio de venta al público del producto original
penalty_formula: Damages for material and/or moral harm and indemnity for losses in no case less than 40 percent of the retail price of the original product or service; the judge with expert hearing sets the amount where it cannot be determined under this rule; moral damage covers violations of Art. 21 I, II, III, IV and VI

authority: Instituto Federal de Telecomunicaciones
triggered_by: Preponderant economic agent's plan is not executed within the period (or the IFT denies the certification, or finds the plan not fully executed) under the Décimo Segundo transitorio procedure
max_penalty_text: not stated
quote: se dejarán sin efectos los acuerdos de compensación recíproca de tráfico y la suspensión de las tarifas
penalty_formula: not stated

authority: not named in provision (economic sanctions under the Ley Federal de Telecomunicaciones y Radiodifusión)
triggered_by: Authorization procedure for additional services or transition to the single concession by preponderant agents and concessionaires with express service restrictions (Décimo Primero transitorio)
max_penalty_text: not stated
penalty_reference: Ley Federal de Telecomunicaciones y Radiodifusión (economic sanctions; cross-reference only)
quote: será independiente de las sanciones económicas que procedan conforme a la Ley Federal de Telecomunicaciones y Radiodifusión
penalty_formula: not stated

authority: not named in provision
triggered_by: Radio broadcasting permit holders that do not comply with the transition to the concession regime required by the Décimo Séptimo transitorio
max_penalty_text: not stated
quote: En caso de no cumplir con el presente artículo, los permisos concluirán su vigencia.
penalty_formula: not stated

authority: Instituto Nacional Electoral (verifies compliance and applies the corresponding sanctions, per the text)
triggered_by: Delivery, distribution or replacement of receiving equipment, decoders or digital televisions during electoral processes in contravention of the suspension in the transitorio
max_penalty_text: not stated
penalty_reference: Ley General de Instituciones y Procedimientos Electorales
provision: Transitorio Tercero (decree amending Décimo Noveno Transitorio, DOF 18-12-2015)
quote: será sancionada en términos de la Ley General de Instituciones y Procedimientos Electorales
penalty_formula: not stated

authority: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social
triggered_by: Subcontracting service providers (personas físicas o morales) that do not meet the requirements of this Law, at any time after registration
max_penalty_text: No penalty amount stated; the registration is denied or cancelled
quote: negará o cancelará en cualquier tiempo el registro de aquellas personas físicas o morales que no cumplan con los requisitos previstos por esta Ley.
penalty_formula: not applicable

authority: Autoridades del trabajo (detect the conduct); sanctioning authority not named in this provision
triggered_by: Employer who has a child under fifteen working outside the family circle (Art. 23)
max_penalty_text: Penalty established in Art. 995 Bis of this Law (amount not stated in this part)
quote: Al patrón que incurra en esta conducta se le sancionará con la pena establecida en el artículo 995 Bis de esta Ley.
penalty_formula: not stated in this provision

authority: Not named in this provision (imposed within labour proceedings under Art. 48)
triggered_by: Lawyers, litigants or representatives who file manifestly improper actions to prolong, delay or obstruct a labour trial (examples in Art. 48 Bis, I)
max_penalty_text: multa de 100 a 1000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
quote: se le impondrá una multa de 100 a 1000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización.
penalty_formula: 100 to 1000 times the UMA

authority: Not named; the 'disposiciones aplicables' govern the procedure
triggered_by: Delay in a labour proceeding caused by omissions or irregular conduct of public servants (Art. 48)
max_penalty_text: Suspension for up to ninety days without pay; removal from office (destitución) in case of recidivism
quote: la sanción aplicable será la suspensión hasta por noventa días sin pago de salario y en caso de reincidencia la destitución del cargo
penalty_formula: suspension up to 90 days without salary; destitution on repeat offence

authority: Not named in this provision (sanction on officials of the Centro Federal de Conciliación y Registro Laboral and local conciliation centres)
triggered_by: Officials who delay, obstruct or influence union registrations, collective contracts, internal work rules or representativity certificates without cause, in favour of or against one party
max_penalty_text: multa de 100 a 1000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
quote: se les impondrá una multa de 100 a 1000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
penalty_formula: 100 to 1000 times the UMA

authority: Not named in this provision; the text refers to sanctions under the Ley General de Responsabilidades Administrativas and to a referral to the Ministerio Público
triggered_by: Grave delay in labour proceedings caused by omissions or irregular conduct of public servants (Art. 48 Bis, II)
max_penalty_text: multa de 100 a 1000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización, in addition to sanctions under the Ley General de Responsabilidades Administrativas
penalty_reference: Ley General de Responsabilidades Administrativas (cross-reference, not in this text); Art. 48 Bis, II, último párrafo
provision: Art. 48 Bis, fracción II, último párrafo
quote: se les impondrá a quienes resulten responsables una multa de 100 a 1000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
penalty_formula: 100 to 1000 times the UMA, cumulative with administrative-responsibility sanctions

authority: Autoridad Conciliadora or Tribunal (claim by the worker)
triggered_by: Dismissal where the employer does not prove the cause of rescission in the proceeding (Art. 48)
max_penalty_text: Reinstatement, or indemnity of three months' salary, plus back wages up to twelve months; interest at two percent per month on fifteen months' salary if the procedure is not concluded
quote: que se le indemnice con el importe de tres meses de salario
penalty_formula: three months' salary or reinstatement; back wages up to 12 months; interest 2% monthly on 15 months' salary after the period

authority: Tribunal (claim by the worker)
triggered_by: Employer's failure to comply with the hiring and seniority preference obligations of Arts. 154 and 156
max_penalty_text: Worker may request the position or an indemnity of three months' salary, plus salaries and interest where applicable
quote: da derecho al trabajador para solicitar ante el Tribunal, a su elección, que se le otorgue el puesto correspondiente o se le indemnice con el importe de tres meses de salario
penalty_formula: choice of position or three months' salary; plus back salaries and interest per Art. 48 second paragraph

authority: Not named in this provision; registration under Art. 153-A is granted by the Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social
triggered_by: Contravention of the provisions of this Law by a person or institution holding a training registration
max_penalty_text: Revocation of the registration; no monetary penalty stated
cure_period: none stated; the affected party may offer evidence and argue in the revocation procedure
provision: Art. 153-G, párrafo posterior a la fracción III
quote: El registro concedido en los términos de este artículo podrá ser revocado cuando se contravengan las disposiciones de esta Ley.
penalty_formula: not applicable

authority: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social (adopts measures so the employer complies)
triggered_by: Employer who does not keep training and productivity plans available to the authority, or does not put them into practice
max_penalty_text: Sanction as provided in this Law (not specified here), without prejudice to corrective measures by the Secretaría
penalty_reference: conforme a lo dispuesto en esta Ley (sanction provisions outside this part)
quote: será sancionado conforme a lo dispuesto en esta Ley
penalty_formula: not stated in this provision

authority: Not stated in this text (penalties 'se les aplicarán'; the Oficina de Inspección de Trabajo or the Tribunal refers the facts to the Ministerio Público)
triggered_by: Responsible and direct operators and supervisors of mining works who wilfully or negligently fail to implement safety measures, after written identification in a reasoned dictamen by the competent authority
max_penalty_text: Up to 2,000 UMA (partial permanent disability); up to 3,500 UMA (total permanent disability); up to 5,000 UMA (death of the worker)
quote: Multa de hasta 2,000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
penalty_formula: Tiered maximum fines by outcome: fracción I partial permanent disability; fracción II total permanent disability; fracción III death of a worker

authority: Oficina de Inspección de Trabajo or the Tribunal hearing the case (referral)
triggered_by: Same conduct as the fines in Art. 343-E: failure to implement safety measures by responsible and direct operators and supervisors of mining works
max_penalty_text: No penalty stated in this provision; the facts are referred to the Ministerio Público, without prejudice to the fines
quote: dé vista de los hechos al Ministerio Público

authority: Inspección del Trabajo (Inspectores del Trabajo); suspension of mining works is then carried out by the autoridad minera
triggered_by: Inspection confirms an imminent-risk situation (situación de riesgo inminente) reported by workers or others
max_penalty_text: Total or partial suspension of mine activities and restriction of workers' access to the workplace until safety measures are adopted; no monetary amount stated
penalty_reference: Ley de la materia (mining law, not in this part)
cure_period: Until the safety measures needed to inhibit the occurrence of an accident are adopted; no fixed period stated
quote: suspensión total o parcial de las actividades de la mina

authority: Inspectores del Trabajo (registry enforcement); penalties referred to in this Law
triggered_by: Employers giving home work who are not registered in the Registro de patrones del trabajo a domicilio, after the inspector's order to register
max_penalty_text: Sanctions 'que señala esta Ley'; the amount is not stated in this part
penalty_reference: Sanctions provided elsewhere in this Law (outside this part)
cure_period: Registration within a term not greater than 10 days after the inspector's order
quote: apercibiéndolas que de no hacerlo en un término no mayor de 10 días

authority: Not stated in this text
triggered_by: Acts of interference (injerencia) in the constitution, functioning or administration of workers' or employers' organizations, as defined in Art. 357
max_penalty_text: Sanction as provided by the Law ('en los términos que disponga la Ley'); no penalty stated in this part
quote: Cualquier injerencia indebida será sancionada en los términos que disponga la Ley.

authority: Tribunales (courts), which resolve on cancellation of the union registration
triggered_by: Dissolution, loss of legal requirements, or union leaders, attorneys or legal representatives committing extortion against employers to obtain payment in exchange for desisting from a strike or contract-ownership claim (fracción III)
max_penalty_text: Cancellation of the union, federation or confederation registration; no monetary penalty stated in this provision
quote: apoderados o representantes legales incurran en actos de extorsión en contra de los patrones

authority: Órganos sindicales competentes (union internal bodies), under the procedure set in the union statutes
triggered_by: Responsible persons for irregularities in the management of union funds, where union statutes do not provide effective and proportionate sanctions
max_penalty_text: Suspension or removal from office, according to the gravity of the irregularity; without prejudice to other legal actions
quote: sancionados por los órganos sindicales competentes con la suspensión o destitución de su cargo

authority: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social
triggered_by: Failure to carry out workplace modifications ordered by labour authorities within the granted period, to bring establishments, installations or equipment into line with the Law, its regulations or NOMs
max_penalty_text: Sanction not specified in this part of the text; a stronger sanction is threatened if the new order is not complied with
penalty_reference: Art. 512-D (sanction amount not stated in this part)
cure_period: The period granted by the authority to carry out the modifications (length not stated in this part)
quote: la Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social procederá a sancionar al patrón infractor, con apercibimiento de sanción mayor en caso de no cumplir la orden

authority: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social
triggered_by: Restriction of access or limitation of operation in risk areas detected under Art. 541, fracción VI Bis
max_penalty_text: Restriction is maintained until the irregularities that motivated the suspension of activities are corrected; duration not otherwise stated
penalty_reference: Art. 541, fracción VI Bis (referenced; not in this part)
cure_period: Employer may submit arguments and evidence within the 72-hour period before the authority resolves
quote: resolverá dentro de las siguientes 72 horas si levanta la restricción decretada o amplía su duración

authority: Not specified in this provision
triggered_by: Non-compliance with the provisions on safety and hygiene at work
max_penalty_text: Economic sanction referred to but amount not stated in this part of the text
penalty_reference: Art. 512-D Bis (amount not stated in this part)
quote: independientemente de la imposición de la sanción económica que corresponda por el incumplimiento a las disposiciones en materia de seguridad e higiene en el trabajo

authority: Tribunal
triggered_by: Inexcusable fault of the employer, including non-compliance with legal, regulatory and NOM provisions on safety, health and work environment
max_penalty_text: Indemnity may be increased by up to twenty-five percent, at the Tribunal's discretion
quote: la indemnización podrá aumentarse hasta en un veinticinco por ciento, a juicio del Tribunal
penalty_formula: Increase of the indemnity up to 25%

authority: Director General de la Inspección del Trabajo (amonestación y suspensión); Secretario del Trabajo y Previsión Social, Gobernador del Estado o Jefe de Gobierno de la Ciudad de México (destitución)
triggered_by: Causas especiales de responsabilidad de los Inspectores del Trabajo (art. 547), por ejemplo no practicar inspecciones, asentar hechos falsos o recibir dádivas
max_penalty_text: Amonestación; Suspensión hasta por tres meses; y Destitución. Sanciones que pueden imponerse independientemente de las leyes penales
quote: independientemente de lo que dispongan las leyes penales, son:

authority: Juez o Tribunal que dirige la audiencia o diligencia
triggered_by: Conducta que altere el buen orden en el desarrollo de las audiencias o diligencias (art. 728)
max_penalty_text: Multa, que no podrá exceder de 100 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización en el momento en que se cometa la falta. Tratándose de trabajadores, no podrá exceder del importe de su jornal o salario en un día
quote: Multa, que no podrá exceder de 100 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización en el momento
penalty_formula: Maximum 100 UMA at the time of the offence; for workers, not more than one day's wage or salary

authority: Juez o Tribunal que dirige la audiencia o diligencia
triggered_by: Conducta que altere el buen orden en el desarrollo de las audiencias o diligencias (art. 728)
max_penalty_text: Amonestación; Expulsión del local del Tribunal, con auxilio de la fuerza pública si se resiste
quote: Expulsión del local del Tribunal; la persona que se resista a cumplir la orden, será desalojada

authority: Juez (medios de apremio para asegurar la comparecencia o el cumplimiento de resoluciones)
triggered_by: Falta de comparecencia a audiencias donde la presencia es indispensable, o incumplimiento de resoluciones judiciales (desacato)
max_penalty_text: Multa, que no podrá exceder de 200 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización en el momento en que se cometió el desacato. Tratándose de trabajadores, no podrá exceder de un día de jornal o salario
quote: Multa, que no podrá exceder de 200 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización en el momento
penalty_formula: Maximum 200 UMA at the time of the contempt; for workers, not more than one day's wage or salary

authority: Juez (medios de apremio)
triggered_by: Desacato o falta de comparecencia a audiencias donde la presencia es indispensable
max_penalty_text: Arresto hasta por treinta y seis horas (medio de apremio; also presentación de la persona con auxilio de la fuerza pública)
quote: Arresto hasta por treinta y seis horas.

authority: Tribunal (Poder Judicial competente)
triggered_by: Recusación declarada improcedente
max_penalty_text: Multa a favor del Fondo de Apoyo a la Administración de Justicia, no inferior a 100 ni mayor a 500 Unidades de Medida y Actualización
quote: inferior a 100 ni mayor a 500 Unidades de Medida y Actualización.
penalty_formula: Minimum 100 UMA and maximum 500 UMA; payable to the Fondo de Apoyo a la Administración de Justicia

authority: Tribunal (juez o secretario instructor)
triggered_by: Incidente notoriamente improcedente en el Juicio Individual Ordinario
max_penalty_text: Multa de hasta 100 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
quote: A quien promueva un incidente notoriamente improcedente, se le impondrá una multa de hasta 100
penalty_formula: Up to 100 UMA

authority: Autoridad Conciliadora (Centro de Conciliación competente)
triggered_by: Patrón que no comparece a la audiencia de conciliación, sin representante ni apoderado, tras la notificación personal
max_penalty_text: Multa entre 50 y 100 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
quote: una multa entre 50 y 100 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
penalty_formula: Between 50 and 100 UMA

authority: Parties to the conciliation agreement, under the Autoridad Conciliadora's supervision
triggered_by: Incumplimiento de pagos diferidos previstos en el convenio de conciliación
max_penalty_text: Pena convencional: una cantidad no menor al salario diario del trabajador por cada día que transcurra sin cumplimiento del convenio
quote: ésta consistirá en una cantidad no menor al salario diario del trabajador por cada día que
penalty_formula: Not less than the worker's daily wage for each day without full compliance with the agreement

authority: Inspectores del Trabajo (with prior authorisation under art. 541 fr. VI Bis)
triggered_by: Peligro inminente para la vida, la salud o la integridad de las personas en un centro de trabajo
max_penalty_text: Restricción de acceso o limitación de la operación en las áreas de riesgo detectadas (medida de seguridad de aplicación inmediata)
quote: deberán decretar la restricción de acceso o limitar la operación en las áreas de riesgo detectadas

authority: Leyes de responsabilidades administrativas de los servidores públicos (as referred to by the text)
triggered_by: Failure to keep cases active (juicios inactivos) by the Tribunal responsible
max_penalty_text: Sanciones que establezcan las leyes de responsabilidades administrativas de los servidores públicos (amount not stated in this text)
penalty_reference: Art. 771 (refers to the administrative responsibility laws of public servants)
quote: se harán acreedores a las sanciones que establezcan las Leyes de

authority: Secretario del Trabajo y Previsión Social, Gobernadores de los Estados o Jefe de Gobierno de la Ciudad de México (Art. 1008, for sanctions under this Título)
triggered_by: Digital platform administrators acting as employers (patrón) who violate the protective rules for digital platform work: failure to register the contract model (Art. 291-G), failure to issue or report changes to the algorithmic management policy document (Art. 291-J), violation of Art. 291-K, or failure to establish the mechanisms in Art. 291-P
max_penalty_text: Fracción I: 2,000 to 25,000 UMA (contract model not registered, art. 291-G); Fracción II: 1,000 to 25,000 UMA (algorithmic management policy document not issued or changes not reported, art. 291-J); Fracción III: 250 to 5,000 UMA (violation of art. 291-K); Fracción IV: 500 to 25,000 UMA (mechanisms of art. 291-P not established)

quote: con independencia de las sanciones que correspondan en las leyes respectivas, se les impondrá una multa por el equivalente a:

authority: Comisión Reguladora de Telecomunicaciones
triggered_by: Transmissions that violate the rules on audience rights (fracción LI) or children's programming and advertising (fracción LII)
max_penalty_text: No amount stated; precautionary suspension of transmissions, after prior warning (previo apercibimiento)
